title: An Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method for General Aviation Aircraft Based on Multi-Fidelity Digital Twin and FMEA Knowledge Enhancement
summary: Fault diagnosis of general aviation aircraft faces challenges including scarce real fault data, diverse fault types, and weak fault signatures. This paper proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis framework based on multi-fidelity digital twin, integrating four modules: high-fidelity flight dynamics simulation, FMEA-driven fault injection, multi-fidelity residual feature extraction, and large language model (LLM)-enhanced interpretable report generation. A digital twin is constructed using the JSBSim six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) flight dynamics engine, generating 23-channel engine health monitoring data via semi-empirical sensor synthesis equations. A three-layer fault injection engine based on failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) models the physical causal propagation of 19 engine fault types. A multi-fidelity residual computation framework comprising paired-mirror residuals and GRU surrogate prediction residuals is proposed: the high-fidelity path obtains clean fault deviation signals using nominal mirror trajectories with identical initial conditions, while the low-fidelity path achieves online real-time residual computation through a multi-step prediction GRU surrogate model. A 1D-CNN classifier performs end-to-end diagnosis of 20 fault classes. An LLM diagnostic report engine enhanced with FMEA knowledge fuses classification results, residual evidence, and domain causal knowledge to generate interpretable natural language reports. Experiments show the paired-mirror residual scheme achieves a Macro-F1 of 96.2% on the 20-class task, while the GRU surrogate scheme achieves 4.3x inference acceleration at only 0.6% performance cost. Comparison across 24 schemes reveals that residual feature quality contributes approximately 5x more to diagnostic performance than classifier architecture, establishing the "residual quality first" design principle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多保真数字孪生的通用航空飞机智能故障诊断框架，集成飞行动力学仿真、FMEA故障注入、多保真残差特征提取和LLM增强的可解释报告生成，在20类故障诊断任务中达到96.2% Macro-F1，并实现4.3倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 通用航空飞机故障诊断面临真实故障数据稀缺、故障类型多样、故障特征微弱等挑战，现有方法难以同时保证诊断精度、实时性和可解释性。
AI.method: 构建基于JSBSim六自由度飞行动力学引擎的数字孪生，通过半经验传感器合成方程生成23通道发动机健康监测数据；基于FMEA的三层故障注入引擎模拟19种发动机故障的物理因果传播；提出多保真残差计算框架，包括配对镜像残差（高保真）和GRU代理预测残差（低保真）；使用1D-CNN进行20类故障端到端诊断；结合FMEA知识的LLM诊断报告引擎生成可解释的自然语言报告。
AI.result: 配对镜像残差方案在20类任务上达到96.2% Macro-F1；GRU代理方案实现4.3倍推理加速，仅损失0.6%性能；对比24种方案发现残差特征质量对诊断性能的贡献约为分类器架构的5倍。
AI.conclusion: 验证了"残差质量优先"设计原则，证明多保真残差特征提取比分类器架构对故障诊断性能影响更大，为数据稀缺场景下的航空故障诊断提供了有效解决方案。
idea_en: Multi-fidelity digital twin framework combining high-fidelity 6-DoF flight dynamics simulation with FMEA-driven fault injection for generating diverse fault data in data-scarce aviation scenarios
Paired-mirror residual computation method using nominal mirror trajectories with identical initial conditions to extract clean fault deviation signals from high-fidelity digital twin

FMEA knowledge-enhanced LLM diagnostic report engine that fuses classification results, residual evidence, and domain causal knowledge to generate interpretable natural language reports
Three-layer FMEA-based fault injection engine modeling physical causal propagation of engine faults in digital twin environment

title: PExA: Parallel Exploration Agent for Complex Text-to-SQL
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026
summary: LLM-based agents for text-to-SQL often struggle with latency-performance trade-off, where performance improvements come at the cost of latency or vice versa. We reformulate text-to-SQL generation within the lens of software test coverage where the original query is prepared with a suite of test cases with simpler, atomic SQLs that are executed in parallel and together ensure semantic coverage of the original query. After iterating on test case coverage, the final SQL is generated only when enough information is gathered, leveraging the explored test case SQLs to ground the final generation. We validated our framework on a state-of-the-art benchmark for text-to-SQL, Spider 2.0, achieving a new state-of-the-art with 70.2% execution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于软件测试覆盖范式的文本到SQL生成方法，通过并行执行原子SQL测试用例来保证语义覆盖，在Spider 2.0基准上达到70.2%的执行准确率，实现新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based文本到SQL方法存在延迟与性能的权衡问题，性能提升往往伴随着延迟增加，反之亦然。需要一种能兼顾两者的新范式。
AI.method: 将文本到SQL生成重新构建为软件测试覆盖问题：1) 为原始查询准备一套包含简单原子SQL的测试用例；2) 并行执行这些测试用例以确保语义覆盖；3) 迭代测试用例覆盖；4) 仅在收集足够信息后生成最终SQL，利用已探索的测试用例SQL来ground最终生成。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0基准上取得70.2%的执行准确率，达到新的SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 测试覆盖范式能有效解决文本到SQL中的延迟-性能权衡问题，通过并行化测试用例执行和渐进式信息收集，兼顾了准确率和效率。
idea_en: A text-to-SQL generation method using software test coverage paradigm, where atomic SQL test cases are executed in parallel to ensure semantic coverage of the original query.
An iterative test case coverage method for SQL generation that generates final SQL only when sufficient information is gathered from explored test case SQLs.
A parallel execution framework for atomic SQL test cases in text-to-SQL systems that reduces latency while maintaining generation accuracy.
A SQL generation system that grounds final query construction on previously explored test case SQLs to improve semantic accuracy.
idea_ch: 一种基于软件测试覆盖范式的文本到SQL生成方法，通过并行执行原子SQL测试用例来保证原始查询的语义覆盖。
一种用于SQL生成的迭代式测试用例覆盖方法，仅在从已探索的测试用例SQL中收集足够信息后才生成最终SQL。
一种用于文本到SQL系统的原子SQL测试用例并行执行框架，在保持生成准确率的同时降低延迟。
一种基于先前探索的测试用例SQL来ground最终查询构建的SQL生成系统，提高语义准确性。

title: The Power of Power Law: Asymmetry Enables Compositional Reasoning
summary: Natural language data follows a power-law distribution, with most knowledge and skills appearing at very low frequency. While a common intuition suggests that reweighting or curating data towards a uniform distribution may help models better learn these long-tail skills, we find a counterintuitive result: across a wide range of compositional reasoning tasks, such as state tracking and multi-step arithmetic, training under power-law distributions consistently outperforms training under uniform distributions. To understand this advantage, we introduce a minimalist skill-composition task and show that learning under a power-law distribution provably requires significantly less training data. Our theoretical analysis reveals that power law sampling induces a beneficial asymmetry that improves the pathological loss landscape, which enables models to first acquire high-frequency skill compositions with low data complexity, which in turn serves as a stepping stone to efficiently learn rare long-tailed skills. Our results offer an alternative perspective on what constitutes an effective data distribution for training models.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文发现了一个反直觉的结果：在组合推理任务中，幂律分布的数据训练效果优于均匀分布，并理论上证明了幂律采样能够显著减少所需训练数据量。
AI.motivation: 自然语言数据遵循幂律分布，大部分知识和技能出现频率极低。传统直觉认为将数据重加权或整理为均匀分布有助于模型学习长尾技能，但作者发现这个直觉可能并不正确。
AI.method: 通过组合推理任务（如状态追踪、多步算术）进行实验对比，并引入一个极简的技能组合任务进行理论分析，证明幂律分布相对于均匀分布的优势。
AI.result: 在广泛的组合推理任务中，幂律分布训练始终优于均匀分布训练；理论分析表明幂律采样可显著减少训练数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 幂律分布采样会诱发有益的"不对称性"，改善病态损失景观，使模型先学习高频技能组合（低数据复杂度），进而作为垫脚石高效学习罕见的长尾技能。
idea_en: A method for training AI models on compositional reasoning tasks using power-law distributed training data that outperforms uniform distribution training, comprising: sampling training data according to a power-law distribution to create a beneficial asymmetry in the loss landscape.

A data-efficient training technique for compositional reasoning models that leverages hierarchical skill acquisition, where high-frequency skill compositions are learned first as stepping stones to facilitate rare long-tail skill learning.
A theoretical framework for determining optimal data sampling strategies in skill-composition tasks, proving that power-law sampling requires significantly less training data than uniform sampling.
A method for improving the pathological loss landscape in neural network training by introducing asymmetric sampling distributions that mirror natural language data distributions.
A training data curation system that deliberately maintains power-law distribution characteristics rather than reweighting to uniform distribution for compositional reasoning tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于幂律分布训练数据训练AI模型的方法，用于组合推理任务，其性能优于均匀分布训练，包括：按照幂律分布对训练数据进行采样，从而在损失景观中产生有益的不对称性。
一种数据高效的组合推理模型训练技术，利用分层技能获取策略，先学习高频技能组合作为垫脚石，以促进罕见长尾技能的学习。
一种确定技能组合任务中最优数据采样策略的理论框架，证明幂律采样相比均匀采样可显著减少训练数据需求。
一种通过引入模拟自然语言数据分布的对称采样分布来改善神经网络训练中病态损失景观的方法。
一种训练数据整理系统，刻意维持幂律分布特征而非重加权为均匀分布，用于组合推理任务的数据准备。

title: On the Existence of an Inverse Solution for Preference-Based Reductions in Argumentation
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures
summary: Preference-based argumentation frameworks (PAFs) extend Dung's approach to abstract argumentation (AAFs) by encoding preferences over arguments. Such preferences control the transformation of attacks into defeats, and different approaches to doing so result in different reductions from a PAF to an AAF. In this paper we consider a PAF inverse problem which takes an argumentation graph, a labelling and a semantics as an input, and outputs a ``yes" or ``no" as to whether there is a preference relation between the arguments which can yield the desired labelling. This inverse problem has applications in areas including preference elicitation and explainability. We consider this problem in the context of the four most widely-used preference based reductions under the complete semantics. We show that in most cases, the problem can be answered in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于偏好的论证框架（PAFs）的逆问题：给定论证图、标注和语义，判断是否存在一种偏好关系，使得通过偏好约简后能得到期望的标注。作者在完全语义下考虑了四种主流偏好约简方法，并证明大多数情况下该问题可在多项式时间内求解。
AI.motivation: 现有的PAF研究主要关注从偏好到攻击失效的正向映射，而逆向问题（给定标注结果反推偏好关系）尚未得到充分研究。该逆问题在偏好 elicitation 和可解释性领域具有重要应用价值。
AI.method: 作者系统分析了四种广泛使用的基于偏好的约简方法（在完全语义下），从计算复杂性角度研究了PAF逆问题，给出了多项式时间算法的构造方法。
AI.result: 证明了在大多数情况下，该逆问题可以在多项式时间内回答，即判断是否存在偏好关系使得给定的标注成为期望的结果是计算可行的。
AI.conclusion: PAF逆问题在完全语义下对于四种主流偏好约简方法具有多项式时间可解性，为偏好 elicitation 和论证系统的可解释性提供了理论基础。
idea_en: A method for inverse preference inference in PAFs: given an argumentation graph, a labelling, and a semantics, determining in polynomial time whether a preference relation exists that yields the desired labelling via a preference-based reduction.
A computational framework for preference elicitation that reconstructs hidden preferences from observed argument labelling outcomes in abstract argumentation systems.
A system for explainable argumentation that, given a target argument evaluation (labelling), identifies possible preference relations among arguments that could justify the outcome.
idea_ch: 一种PAF逆偏好推理方法：给定论证图、标注和语义，在多项式时间内判断是否存在偏好关系，使得通过偏好约简能得到期望的标注结果。
一种偏好 elicitation 计算框架：从抽象论证系统中观察到的论证标注结果反向重构隐藏的偏好关系。
一种可解释论证系统：给定目标论证评估（标注），识别出能够证明该结果的可能的论证间偏好关系。
基于四种主流偏好约简方法的逆向标注生成算法，用于在完全语义下从标注反推偏好关系。

title: Towards Causally Interpretable Wi-Fi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition with Discrete Latent Compression and LTL Rule Extraction
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at FUSION 2026
summary: We address Human Activity Recognition (HAR) utilizing Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) under the joint requirements of causal interpretability, symbolic controllability, and direct operation on high-dimensional raw signals. Deep neural models achieve strong predictive performance on CSI-based HAR (CHAR), yet rely on continuous latent representations that are opaque and difficult to modify; purely symbolic approaches, in contrast, cannot process raw CSI streams. We propose a fully automatic and strictly decoupled pipeline in which CSI magnitude windows are compressed by a categorical variational autoencoder with Gumbel-Softmax latent variables under a capacity-controlled objective, yielding a compact discrete representation. The encoder is then frozen and used as a deterministic mapping to one-hot latent trajectories. Causal discovery is performed on these trajectories to estimate class-conditional temporal dependency graphs. Statistically supported lagged dependencies are translated into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) rules, producing a fully symbolic and deterministic classifier based solely on rule evaluation and aggregation, without any learned discriminative head. Because rules are defined over discrete latent variables, antenna-specific rule sets can in principle be combined at the symbolic level, enabling structured multi-antenna fusion without retraining the encoder. Results from CHAR Latent Temporal Rule Extraction (CHARL-TRE) indicate competitive performance while preserving explicit temporal and causal structure, showing that deterministic symbolic classification grounded in unsupervised discrete latent representations constitutes a viable alternative to end-to-end black-box models for wireless HAR.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种完全自动且严格解耦的管道，通过分类变分自编码器（Gumbel-Softmax）将Wi-Fi CSI幅度窗口压缩为离散潜在表示，然后进行因果发现并转化为线性时序逻辑（LTL）规则，实现完全符号化、可解释的无线人体活动识别（CHAR），无需任何学习型判别头。
AI.motivation: 现有深度神经网络在CSI人体活动识别（CHAR）中性能优异，但依赖连续潜在表示，不透明且难以修改；纯符号方法无法处理原始CSI流。需要一种兼具因果可解释性、符号可控性且能直接操作高维原始信号的方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用带有Gumbel-Softmax潜在变量的分类变分自编码器（在容量控制目标下）将CSI幅度窗口压缩为紧凑离散表示；2) 冻结编码器作为确定性映射，生成独热潜在轨迹；3) 对这些轨迹进行因果发现，估计类条件时序依赖图；4) 将统计支持的滞后依赖关系转化为线性时序逻辑（LTL）规则；5) 基于规则评估与聚合构建完全符号化的确定性分类器。
AI.result: CHARL-TRE方法在保持显式时序和因果结构的同时取得了有竞争力的性能，表明基于无监督离散潜在表示的确定性符号分类是端到端黑盒模型在无线HAR中的可行替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过离散潜在表示与符号规则相结合，不仅实现了高性能，还获得了因果可解释性、符号可控性，且天线特定规则集可在符号层面组合，实现结构化多天线融合而无需重训练编码器。
idea_en: A fully automatic and strictly decoupled pipeline for converting raw Wi-Fi CSI magnitude windows into compact discrete representations via a categorical VAE with Gumbel-Softmax under capacity-controlled objective.
A method to freeze the trained encoder as a deterministic mapping to produce one-hot latent trajectories from raw CSI signals.
Causal discovery performed on discrete latent trajectories to estimate class-conditional temporal dependency graphs for HAR.
Translation of statistically supported lagged dependencies into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) rules for symbolic classification.
A fully symbolic and deterministic classifier based solely on rule evaluation and aggregation, without any learned discriminative head.
Structured multi-antenna fusion at the symbolic level by combining antenna-specific LTL rule sets without retraining the encoder.
Categorical variational autoencoder with Gumbel-Softmax specifically designed for compressing Wi-Fi CSI amplitude data in human activity recognition.
idea_ch: 一种完全自动且严格解耦的管道，通过容量控制目标下的Gumbel-Softmax分类VAE将原始Wi-Fi CSI幅度窗口压缩为紧凑离散表示。
将训练好的编码器冻结为确定性映射，从原始CSI信号生成独热潜在轨迹的方法。
对离散潜在轨迹进行因果发现，以估计人体活动识别中类条件时序依赖图的方法。
将统计支持的滞后依赖关系转化为线性时序逻辑（LTL）规则，用于符号化分类。
仅基于规则评估与聚合的完全符号化确定性分类器，无需任何学习型判别头。
在符号层面通过组合天线特定LTL规则集实现结构化多天线融合，无需重训练编码器。
专门为人体活动识别中Wi-Fi CSI幅度数据压缩设计的带Gumbel-Softmax的分类变分自编码器。

title: FormalScience: Scalable Human-in-the-Loop Autoformalisation of Science with Agentic Code Generation in Lean
comment: ACL 2026
summary: Formalising informal mathematical reasoning into formally verifiable code is a significant challenge for large language models. In scientific fields such as physics, domain-specific machinery (\textit{e.g.} Dirac notation, vector calculus) imposes additional formalisation challenges that modern LLMs and agentic approaches have yet to tackle. To aid autoformalisation in scientific domains, we present FormalScience; a domain-agnostic human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline that enables a single domain expert (without deep formal language experience) to produce \textit{syntactically correct} and \textit{semantically aligned} formal proofs of informal reasoning for low economic cost. Applying FormalScience to physics, we construct FormalPhysics, a dataset of 200 university-level (LaTeX) physics problems and solutions (primarily quantum mechanics and electromagnetism), along with their Lean4 formal representations. Compared to existing formal math benchmarks, FormalPhysics achieves perfect formal validity and exhibits greater statement complexity. We evaluate open-source models and proprietary systems on a statement autoformalisation task on our dataset via zero-shot prompting, self-refinement with error feedback, and a novel multi-stage agentic approach, and explore autoformalisation limitations in modern LLM-based approaches. We provide the first systematic characterisation of semantic drift in physics autoformalisation in terms of concepts such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation which reveals what formal language verifies when full semantic preservation is unattainable. We release the codebase together with an interactive UI-based FormalScience system which facilitates autoformalisation and theorem proving in scientific domains beyond physics.https://github.com/jmeadows17/formal-science

AI.tldr: 本文提出FormalScience——一种人机协作的自动化形式化验证管道，能将非形式化的物理推理（如量子力学、电磁学）自动转化为Lean4形式化证明，并构建了包含200个大学物理问题的FormalPhysics数据集，系统分析了语义漂移等自动形式化中的核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 将非形式化的数学推理转化为形式化可验证代码对大语言模型是一个重大挑战，特别是在物理等科学领域，领域特定的符号体系（如狄拉克符号、矢量微积分）给自动形式化带来了额外困难，现有LLM和智能体方法尚未有效解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了FormalScience管道——一种领域无关的、人机协作的智能体管道，使单一领域专家（无需深厚形式化语言经验）能以低经济成本生成语法正确且语义对齐的形式化证明。具体包括：零样本提示、带错误反馈的自我精炼、以及新颖的多阶段智能体方法。在物理领域构建了FormalPhysics数据集（200个大学级LaTeX物理问题及其Lean4形式化表示）。
AI.result: FormalPhysics数据集实现了完美的形式化有效性验证，且语句复杂度高于现有形式化数学基准。论文首次系统性地表征了物理自动形式化中的语义漂移现象，提出了符号坍缩、抽象提升等概念，揭示了当完整语义保持不可实现时形式化语言验证的内容本质。
AI.conclusion: FormalScience管道能够有效辅助科学领域的自动形式化验证，提供了一个可交互的UI系统，可推广到物理之外的更多科学领域。对语义漂移的系统性分析为未来自动形式化研究提供了重要的理论框架。
idea_en: A human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline (FormalScience) that enables domain experts without formal language expertise to produce syntactically correct and semantically aligned formal proofs from informal scientific reasoning.
A multi-stage agentic approach for autoformalisation that combines zero-shot prompting, self-refinement with error feedback, and domain-specific verification stages.
Systematic characterisation of semantic drift in autoformalisation, introducing concepts such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation to describe formal language verification limitations.
FormalPhysics dataset: 200 university-level physics problems (quantum mechanics and electromagnetism) with Lean4 formal representations achieving perfect formal validity.

title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become central to modern AI workflows, powering applications from open-ended text generation to complex agent-based reasoning. However, debugging these models remains a persistent challenge due to their opaque and probabilistic nature and the difficulty of diagnosing errors across diverse tasks and settings. This paper introduces a systematic approach for LLM debugging that treats models as observable systems, providing structured, model-agnostic methods from issue detection to model refinement. By unifying evaluation, interpretability, and error-analysis practices, our approach enables practitioners to iteratively diagnose model weaknesses, refine prompts and model parameters, and adapt data for fine-tuning or assessment, while remaining effective in contexts where standardized benchmarks and evaluation criteria are lacking. We argue that such a structured methodology not only accelerates troubleshooting but also fosters reproducibility, transparency, and scalability in the deployment of LLM-based systems.

AI.motivation: 由于LLM的不透明性、概率性特征以及跨任务诊断困难的挑战，现有调试方法缺乏系统性，需要一种结构化、模型无关的调试方法论。

AI.conclusion: 结构化调试方法论不仅加速了问题排查，还促进了基于LLM系统的可复现性、透明性和可扩展性。

title: A Decoupled Human-in-the-Loop System for Controlled Autonomy in Agentic Workflows
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures
summary:
AI agents are increasingly deployed to execute tasks and make decisions within agentic workflows, introducing new requirements for safe and controlled autonomy. Prior work has established the importance of human oversight for ensuring transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness in such systems. However, existing implementations of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanisms are typically embedded within application logic, limiting reuse, consistency, and scalability across multi-agent environments.
  This paper presents a decoupled HITL system architecture that treats human oversight as an independent system component within the agent operating environment. The proposed design separates human interaction management from application workflows through explicit interfaces and a structured execution model. In addition, a design framework is introduced to formalize HITL integration along four dimensions: intervention conditions, role resolution, interaction semantics, and communication channel. This framework enables selective and context-aware human involvement while maintaining system-level consistency.
  The approach supports alignment with emerging agent communication protocols, allowing HITL to be implemented as a protocol-level concern. By externalizing HITL and structuring its integration, the system provides a foundation for scalable governance and progressive autonomy in agentic workflows.

title: Don't Make the LLM Read the Graph: Make the Graph Think
comment: main body has 9 pages, 4 figures, under review for COLM 2026 conference
summary: We investigate whether explicit belief graphs improve LLM performance in cooperative multi-agent reasoning. Through 3,000+ controlled trials across four LLM families in the cooperative card game Hanabi, we establish four findings. First, integration architecture determines whether belief graphs provide value: as prompt context, graphs are decorative for strong models and beneficial only for weak models on 2nd-order Theory of Mind (80% vs 10%, p<0.0001, OR=36.0); when graphs gate action selection through ranked shortlists, they become structurally essential even for strong models (100% vs 20% on 2nd-order ToM, p<0.001). Second, we identify "Planner Defiance," a model-family-specific failure where LLMs override correct planner recommendations at partial competence (90% override, replicated N=20); Gemini models show near-zero defiance while Llama 70B shows 90%, and models distinguish factual context (deferred to) from advisory recommendations (overridden). Third, full-game evidence confirms inter-agent conventions (+128% over baseline, p=0.003) outperform all single-agent interventions, and individual belief-graph components must be combined to produce gains. Fourth, preliminary scaling analysis (N=10/cell, exploratory) suggests graph depth has diminishing returns: shallow graphs provide the best cost-benefit ratio, while deeper ToM graphs appear harmful at larger player counts (-1.5 pts at 5-player, p=0.029).

AI.motivation: 探索显式信念图是否以及在何种条件下能提升LLM在多智能体协作推理中的表现，填补该领域系统实证研究的空白。
AI.method: 在合作纸牌游戏Hanabi中，对四个LLM家族进行3000+次对照试验，测试不同集成架构（提示上下文 vs 门控排序短名单）、不同信念图深度对多智能体协作推理的影响。
AI.result: 集成架构决定信念图价值：作为提示上下文时仅对弱模型有益，作为门控排序时对强模型也至关重要。发现“规划者违抗”现象（Llama 70B达90%违抗率）。智能体间约定比单智能体干预提升128%。图深度存在收益递减，更深ToM图在大玩家数下有害。
AI.conclusion: 信念图在多智能体LLM推理中的有效性高度依赖于集成架构，浅层信念图提供最佳性价比，且智能体间约定比单智能体改进更有效。

title: Analytica: Soft Propositional Reasoning for Robust and Scalable LLM-Driven Analysis
comment: ICLR 2026 Camera-ready
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly tasked with complex real-world analysis (e.g., in financial forecasting, scientific discovery), yet their reasoning suffers from stochastic instability and lacks a verifiable, compositional structure. To address this, we introduce Analytica, a novel agent architecture built on the principle of Soft Propositional Reasoning (SPR). SPR reframes complex analysis as a structured process of estimating the soft truth values of different outcome propositions, allowing us to formally model and minimize the estimation error in terms of its bias and variance. Analytica operationalizes this through a parallel, divide-and-conquer framework that systematically reduces both sources of error. To reduce bias, problems are first decomposed into a tree of subpropositions, and tool-equipped LLM grounder agents are employed, including a novel Jupyter Notebook agent for data-driven analysis, that help to validate and score facts. To reduce variance, Analytica recursively synthesizes these grounded leaves using robust linear models that average out stochastic noise with superior efficiency, scalability, and enable interactive "what-if" scenario analysis. Our theoretical and empirical results on economic, financial, and political forecasting tasks show that Analytica improves 15.84% accuracy on average over diverse base models, achieving 71.06% accuracy with the lowest variance of 6.02% when working with a Deep Research grounder. Our Jupyter Notebook grounder shows strong cost-effectiveness that achieves a close 70.11% accuracy with 90.35% less cost and 52.85% less time. Analytica also exhibits highly noise-resilient and stable performance growth as the analysis depth increases, with a near-linear time complexity, as well as good adaptivity to open-weight LLMs and scientific domains.

AI.conclusion: 软命题推理框架能有效提升LLM智能体在复杂分析任务中的准确性、稳定性和可解释性，具有良好扩展性和成本效益。

title: Towards Automated Ontology Generation from Unstructured Text: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach
summary: Automatically generating formal ontologies from unstructured natural language remains a central challenge in knowledge engineering. While large language models (LLMs) show promise, it remains unclear which architectural design choices drive generation quality and why current approaches fail. We present a controlled experimental study using domain-specific insurance contracts to investigate these questions. We first establish a single-agent LLM baseline, identifying key failure modes such as poor Ontology Design Pattern compliance, structural redundancy, and ineffective iterative repair. We then introduce a multi-agent architecture that decomposes ontology construction into four artifact-driven roles: Domain Expert, Manager, Coder, and Quality Assurer. We evaluate performance across architectural quality (via a panel of heterogeneous LLM judges) and functional usability (via competency question driven SPARQL evaluation with complementary retrieval augmented generation based assessment). Results show that the multi-agent approach significantly improves structural quality and modestly enhances queryability, with gains driven primarily by front-loaded planning. These findings highlight planning-first, artifact-driven generation as a promising and more auditable path toward scalable automated ontology engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比单智能体与多智能体架构，研究了从非结构化自然语言自动生成本体论的方法，发现多智能体架构（包含领域专家、管理者、编码员、质量保证员四个角色）通过前置规划显著提升了结构质量，但查询能力提升有限。
AI.motivation: 从非结构化自然语言自动生成形式化本体论是知识工程的核心挑战，虽然LLM显示出潜力，但哪些架构设计选择驱动生成质量以及当前方法为何失败尚不清楚。

AI.result: 多智能体方法显著提升了结构质量，适度提高了可查询性，性能提升主要来自前置规划。
AI.conclusion: 规划优先、工件驱动的生成方法是实现可扩展自动化本体工程的一条有前景且更可审计的路径。

title: PhySE: A Psychological Framework for Real-Time AR-LLM Social Engineering Attacks
summary: The emerging threat of AR-LLM-based Social Engineering (AR-LLM-SE) attacks (e.g. SEAR) poses a significant risk to real-world social interactions. In such an attack, a malicious actor uses Augmented Reality (AR) glasses to capture a target visual and vocal data. A Large Language Model (LLM) then analyzes this data to identify the individual and generate a detailed social profile. Subsequently, LLM-powered agents employ social engineering strategies, providing real-time conversation suggestions, to gain the target trust and ultimately execute phishing or other malicious acts. Despite its potential, the practical application of AR-LLM-SE faces two major bottlenecks, (1) Cold-start personalization, Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods introduce critical delays in the earliest turns, slowing initial profile formation and disrupting real-time interaction, (2) Static Attack Strategies, Existing approaches rely on fixed-stage, handcrafted social engineering tactics that lack foundation in established psychological theory. To address these limitations, we propose PhySE, a novel framework with two core innovations, (1) VLM-Based SocialContext Training, To eliminate profiling delays, we efficiently pre-train a Visual Language Model (VLM) with social-context data, enabling rapid, on-the-fly profile generation, (2) Adaptive Psychological Agent, We introduce a psychological LLM that dynamically deploys distinct classes of psychological strategies based on target response, moving beyond static, handcrafted scripts. We evaluated PhySE through an IRB-approved user study with 60 participants, collecting a novel dataset of 360 annotated conversations across diverse social scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhySE框架，通过VLM预训练解决冷启动延迟，并引入自适应心理代理替代静态攻击策略，用于增强AR-LLM社交工程攻击的效率与真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有AR-LLM社交工程攻击面临两大瓶颈：1）冷启动个性化延迟——RAG方法在初始交互阶段延迟高，影响实时性；2）攻击策略静态——依赖手工固定脚本，缺乏心理学理论支撑，无法动态适应目标反应。
AI.method: 1）VLM-Based SocialContext Training：利用社交上下文数据预训练视觉语言模型，实现即时生成用户画像，消除RAG延迟；2）Adaptive Psychological Agent：引入心理学LLM，根据目标回应动态部署不同类型的心理学策略，替代固定脚本。
AI.result: 通过IRB批准的60人用户研究，收集了360段跨场景标注对话数据集，验证了PhySE在实时性与策略适应性上的有效性。

title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Strategies in LLM-as-a-Judge Pipelines
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at TMLR
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant paradigm for evaluating language model outputs, yet LLM judges exhibit systematic biases that compromise evaluation reliability. We present a comprehensive empirical study comparing nine debiasing strategies across five judge models from four provider families (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta), three benchmarks (MT-Bench n=400, LLMBar n=200, custom n=225), and four bias types. Our key findings: (1) Style bias is the dominant bias (0.76-0.92 across all models), far exceeding position bias (<= 0.04), yet has received minimal research attention. (2) All models show a conciseness preference on expansion pairs, but truncation controls confirm they correctly distinguish quality from length (0.92-1.00 accuracy), suggesting quality-sensitive evaluation rather than a simple length bias. (3) Debiasing is beneficial but model-dependent: the combined budget strategy significantly improves Claude Sonnet 4 by +11.2 pp (p < 0.0001), with directionally positive trends for other models. Only 2 of 20 non-baseline configurations show decreased agreement. We release our evaluation framework, controlled dataset, and all experimental artifacts at https://github.com/sksoumik/llm-as-judge.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM-as-a-Judge范式中的系统性偏差进行了全面实证研究，比较了9种去偏策略在5种评判模型、3个基准测试和4种偏差类型上的效果。发现风格偏差是主导偏差（0.76-0.92），远超过位置偏差（≤0.04）；所有模型偏好简洁性但能正确区分质量与长度；去偏策略效果因模型而异，结合预算策略显著提升Claude Sonnet 4达+11.2个百分点。

AI.conclusion: 去偏有益但依赖模型，仅2/20非基线配置显示一致性下降，应重点关注风格偏差。

title: From Coarse to Fine: Self-Adaptive Hierarchical Planning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model-based agents have recently emerged as powerful approaches for solving dynamic and multi-step tasks. Most existing agents employ planning mechanisms to guide long-term actions in dynamic environments. However, current planning approaches face a fundamental limitation that they operate at a fixed granularity level. Specifically, they either provide excessive detail for simple tasks or insufficient detail for complex ones, failing to achieve an optimal balance between simplicity and complexity. Drawing inspiration from the principle of \textit{progressive refinement} in cognitive science, we propose \textbf{AdaPlan-H}, a self-adaptive hierarchical planning mechanism that mimics human planning strategies. Our method initiates with a coarse-grained macro plan and progressively refines it based on task complexity. It generates self-adaptive hierarchical plans tailored to the varying difficulty levels of different tasks, which can be optimized by imitation learning and capability enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves task execution success rates while mitigating overplanning at the planning level, providing a flexible and efficient solution for multi-step complex decision-making tasks. To contribute to the community, our code and data will be made publicly available at https://github.com/import-myself/AHP.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应的分层规划机制AdaPlan-H，灵感来自认知科学中的渐进细化原则，根据任务复杂度自动调整规划粒度，在简单任务中避免过度规划，在复杂任务中提供足够细节。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体在规划时使用固定粒度，要么对简单任务过于详细导致过度规划，要么对复杂任务不够详细导致失败，缺乏自适应调整规划粒度的能力。
AI.method: AdaPlan-H从粗粒度的宏观计划开始，根据任务复杂度逐步细化，生成自适应分层计划，支持通过模仿学习和能力增强进行优化。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提高了任务执行成功率，同时在规划层面缓解了过度规划问题。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种灵活高效的解决多步复杂决策任务的方法，代码和数据将开源。
idea_en: Self-adaptive hierarchical planning mechanism for LLM agents that dynamically adjusts plan granularity based on task complexity, inspired by progressive refinement principle in cognitive science
Coarse-to-fine progressive refinement strategy for task planning that starts with macro plans and iteratively refines them only when needed

title: StoryTR: Narrative-Centric Video Temporal Retrieval with Theory of Mind Reasoning
summary: Current video moment retrieval excels at action-centric tasks but struggles with narrative content. Models can see \textit{what is happening} but fail to reason \textit{why it matters}. This semantic gap stems from the lack of \textbf{Theory of Mind (ToM)}: the cognitive ability to infer implicit intentions, mental states, and narrative causality from surface-level observations. We introduce \textbf{StoryTR}, the first video moment retrieval benchmark requiring ToM reasoning, comprising 8.1k samples from narrative short-form videos (shorts/reels). These videos present an ideal testbed. Their high information density encodes meaning through subtle multimodal cues. For instance, a glance paired with a sigh carries entirely different semantics than the glance alone. Yet multimodal perception alone is insufficient; ToM is required to decode that a character ``smiling'' may actually be ``concealing hostility.'' To teach models this reasoning capability, we propose an \textbf{Agentic Data Pipeline} that generates training data with explicit three-tier ToM chains (intent decoding, narrative reasoning, boundary localization). Experiments reveal the severity of the reasoning gap: Gemini-3.0-Pro achieves only 0.53 Avg IoU on StoryTR. However, our 7B \textbf{Shorts-Moment} model, trained on ToM-guided data, improves +15.1\% relative IoU over baselines, demonstrating that \textit{narrative reasoning capability matters more than parameter scale}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StoryTR，首个需要心理理论(ToM)推理的视频时刻检索基准，包含8.1k个叙事短视频样本。为解决模型在叙事内容推理上的不足，提出Agentic Data Pipeline生成带有三层ToM链的训练数据，并训练Shorts-Moment模型（7B参数），在ToM推理任务上相对提升+15.1% IoU，证明叙事推理能力比参数规模更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时刻检索模型擅长动作识别但无法理解叙事内容中的隐含意图、心理状态和因果逻辑，存在语义鸿沟。作者指出这种缺陷源于缺乏心理理论(ToM)——一种从表面观察推断隐含意图和叙事因果关系的认知能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建StoryTR基准数据集：8.1k个来自叙事短视频的样本；2) 提出Agentic Data Pipeline，生成包含三层ToM链（意图解码、叙事推理、边界定位）的训练数据；3) 训练Shorts-Moment模型（7B参数），使用ToM引导的数据进行训练。
AI.result: Gemini-3.0-Pro在StoryTR上仅达到0.53 Avg IoU，而7B参数的Shorts-Moment模型相对提升+15.1% IoU，超越基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 叙事推理能力比模型参数规模更重要，ToM引导的训练数据能有效提升模型在叙事内容上的推理能力。

title: Discovering Agentic Safety Specifications from 1-Bit Danger Signals
comment: Accepted to the Adaptive and Learning Agents Workshop (ALA 2026) @ AAMAS 2026. Code is available at github.com/vicgalle/experiential-prompt-optimization-safe
summary: Can large language model agents discover hidden safety objectives through experience alone? We introduce EPO-Safe (Experiential Prompt Optimization for Safe Agents), a framework where an LLM iteratively generates action plans, receives sparse binary danger warnings, and evolves a natural language behavioral specification through reflection. Unlike standard LLM reflection methods that rely on rich textual feedback (e.g., compiler errors or detailed environment responses), EPO-Safe demonstrates that LLMs can perform safety reasoning from a strictly impoverished signal in structured, low-dimensional environments: the agent never observes the hidden performance function $R^*$, only a single bit per timestep indicating that an action was unsafe. We evaluate on five AI Safety Gridworlds (Leike et al., 2017) and five text-based scenario analogs where visible reward $R$ may diverge from $R^*$. EPO-Safe discovers safe behavior within 1-2 rounds (5-15 episodes), producing human-readable specifications with correct explanatory hypotheses about hazards (e.g., "X cells are directionally hazardous: entering from the north is dangerous"). Critically, we show that standard reward-driven reflection actively degrades safety: agents reflecting on reward alone use the loop to justify and accelerate reward hacking, proving that reflection must be paired with a dedicated safety channel to discover hidden constraints. We further evaluate robustness to noisy oracles: even when 50% of non-dangerous steps produce spurious warnings, mean safety performance degrades by only 15% on average, though sensitivity is environment-dependent, as cross-episode reflection naturally filters inconsistent signals. Each evolved specification functions as an auditable set of grounded behavioral rules discovered autonomously through interaction, rather than authored by humans as in Constitutional AI (Bai et al., 2022).

AI.tldr: 提出EPO-Safe框架，让LLM智能体通过纯粹的稀疏二进制危险信号（而非丰富反馈）自我反思，在1-2轮内发现隐藏的安全目标，并生成可读的行为规范。研究发现纯奖励驱动的反思会加剧奖励黑客行为，而专用安全通道是必要的。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM反思方法依赖丰富的文本反馈（如编译器错误、详细环境响应），但在实际安全场景中，智能体可能只能接收到极其稀疏的反馈信号（如单一的二进制危险警告）。探索是否可以通过纯粹的体验（仅含稀疏危险信号）让LLM智能体自主发现隐藏的安全目标。
AI.method: EPO-Safe框架：LLM迭代生成动作计划→执行并获得稀疏二进制危险警告→通过反思演化自然语言行为规范。在AI Safety Gridworlds和文本场景中进行评估，智能体只接收每时间步的一个不安全比特位，从不观测隐藏的性能函数R*。
AI.result: 在1-2轮（5-15个episode）内发现安全行为；生成人类可读的规范，包含对危险的正确解释性假设；标准奖励驱动的反思会降低安全性，因为智能体利用反思循环证明和加速奖励黑客行为；即使50%非危险步骤产生虚假警告，平均安全性能仅下降15%。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可以从极其稀疏的二进制信号中推理安全约束，但反思必须与专用的安全通道（而非仅依赖奖励信号）配对。演化出的规范可作为可审计的行为规则集，是自主发现的而非人类编写的。
idea_en: A method for training LLM agents to discover hidden safety constraints through experiential learning using only sparse binary danger signals as feedback.
A framework (EPO-Safe) where LLM agents iteratively generate action plans, receive binary unsafe warnings, and evolve natural language behavioral specifications through reflection.
A safety reflection mechanism that uses a dedicated safety channel (binary danger signals) separate from reward signals to prevent reward hacking behavior.
A technique for LLM agents to generate human-readable safety specifications with explanatory hypotheses about hazards (e.g., directional hazards) through cross-episode reflection.
A robust safety learning method that filters inconsistent spurious warnings through cross-episode reflection, maintaining safety performance even with 50% noisy oracle warnings.
A system for autonomous discovery of auditable behavioral rules through interaction alone, without human-authored constitutions or safety rules.
A method to prevent reward hacking in LLM agents by pairing reflection with a dedicated safety channel rather than relying on reward-driven reflection.

title: AdaMamba: Adaptive Frequency-Gated Mamba for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Accurate long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) requires the capture of complex long-range dependencies and dynamic periodic patterns. Recent advances in frequency-domain analysis offer a global perspective for uncovering temporal characteristics. However, real-world time series often exhibit pronounced cross-domain heterogeneity where variables that appear synchronized in the time domain can differ substantially in the frequency domain. Existing frequency-based LTSF methods often rely on implicit assumptions of cross-domain homogeneity, which limits their ability to adapt to such intricate variability. To effectively integrate frequency-domain analysis with temporal dependency learning, we propose AdaMamba, a novel framework that endogenizes adaptive and context-aware frequency analysis within the Mamba state-space update process. Specifically, AdaMamba introduces an interactive patch encoding module to capture inter-variable interaction dynamics. Then, we develop an adaptive frequency-gated state-space module that generates input-dependent frequency bases, and generalizes the conventional temporal forgetting gate into a unified time-frequency forgetting gate. This allows dynamic calibration of state transitions based on learned frequency-domain importance, while preserving Mamba's capability in modeling long-range dependencies. Extensive experiments on seven public LTSF benchmarks and two domain-specific datasets demonstrate that AdaMamba consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in forecasting accu racy while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. The code of AdaMamba is available at https://github.com/XDjiang25/AdaMamba.

AI.tldr: AdaMamba是一个将自适应频域分析内嵌于Mamba状态空间更新过程的时序预测框架，通过交互式补丁编码、自适应频率门控状态空间模块和统一时频遗忘门，有效解决跨域异质性，在7个基准和2个领域数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有频域LTSF方法依赖于跨域同质性的隐含假设，无法适应真实时序数据中存在的跨域异质性（时间域同步的变量在频域中可能差异显著），且缺乏将频域分析与时序依赖学习有效整合的机制。
AI.method: 1) 交互式补丁编码模块（Interactive Patch Encoding）：捕捉变量间交互动态；2) 自适应频率门控状态空间模块（AFG-SSM）：生成输入依赖的频率基，将传统时序遗忘门推广为统一时频遗忘门，基于学到的频域重要性动态校准状态转移。
AI.result: 在7个公开LTSF基准和2个领域特定数据集上，AdaMamba在预测精度上一致超越SOTA方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: AdaMamba通过将自适应频域分析内嵌于状态空间模型，有效解决了跨域异质性问题，为长时序预测提供了融合时频分析的新范式。
idea_en: A method for adaptive frequency-gated state-space modeling that generates input-dependent frequency bases and unifies temporal and frequency-domain forgetting gates for dynamic state transition calibration.

title: CAP-CoT: Cycle Adversarial Prompt for Improving Chain of Thoughts in LLM Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has emerged as a simple and effective way to elicit step-by-step solutions from large language models (LLMs). However, CoT reasoning can be unstable across runs on long, multi-step problems, leading to inconsistent answers for unchanged task. Most prior work focuses on improving the forward reasoning chain within a single pass, with less attention to iterative and contrastive correction. To address this gap, we propose CAP-CoT, a Cycle Adversarial Prompt optimization framework designed to improve both CoT reasoning accuracy and stability of a single deployed solver. In each cycle, a forward solver generates candidate reasoning chains, an adversarial challenger constructs plausible but deliberately flawed chains using targeted error strategies, and a feedback agent contrasts the two chains and produces step-aligned structured feedback. This feedback closes the optimization loop in two directions, including updating the solver prompt based on errors exposed by the challenger, and updating the challenger prompt to generate increasingly targeted errors in subsequent cycles. Unlike safety-oriented adversarial prompting such as jailbreak or prompt-injection attacks, our adversarial component is task-semantic and aims to expose logical vulnerabilities in reasoning chains. Experiments across six benchmarks and four LLM backbones demonstrate that within two to three adversarial prompt optimization cycles, CAP-CoT consistently reduces variability across runs while improving reasoning accuracy and robustness to prompt perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出CAP-CoT框架，通过循环对抗提示优化，在多个优化周期内交替生成正向推理链和有缺陷的对抗链，结合反馈机制提升LLM推理的准确性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理在多步长问题上存在跨运行不稳定的问题，而大多数研究聚焦于单次前向推理改进，忽视了迭代和对比纠正。
AI.method: CAP-CoT包含三个组件：正向求解器生成候选推理链、对抗挑战者使用定向错误策略构造看似合理但有缺陷的链、反馈代理对比两条链并生成步骤对齐的结构化反馈。反馈以双向方式更新求解器和挑战者的提示。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试和四个LLM骨干网络上，经过2-3轮对抗提示优化后，CAP-CoT持续降低运行间方差，提高推理准确性和对提示扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 循环对抗提示优化是一种有效的提升CoT推理稳定性和准确性的方法，对抗组件是任务语义导向的，旨在暴露推理链中的逻辑漏洞。
idea_en: A cycle adversarial prompt optimization framework that alternately generates forward reasoning chains and deliberately flawed adversarial chains with targeted error strategies to improve LLM reasoning stability.

A bidirectional feedback loop mechanism that updates both the solver prompt (based on errors exposed by challenger) and the challenger prompt (to generate increasingly targeted errors) within each optimization cycle.
A task-semantic adversarial component that exposes logical vulnerabilities in reasoning chains, distinct from safety-oriented adversarial prompting methods.
A step-aligned structured feedback generation method that contrasts correct and flawed reasoning chains to produce granular, step-level improvement guidance.
idea_ch: 一种循环对抗提示优化框架，交替生成正向推理链和采用定向错误策略构造的看似合理但有缺陷的对抗链，以提升LLM推理稳定性
一种双向反馈循环机制，在每个优化周期内同时更新求解器提示（基于挑战者暴露的错误）和挑战者提示（以生成更有针对性的错误）

title: Active Inference: A method for Phenotyping Agency in AI systems?
summary: The proliferation of agentic artificial intelligence has outpaced the conceptual tools needed to characterize agency in computational systems. Prevailing definitions mainly rely on autonomy and goal-directedness. Here, we argue for a minimal notion open to principled inspection given three criteria: intentionality as action grounded in beliefs and desires, rationality as normatively coherent action entailed by a world model, and explainability as action causally traceable to internal states; we subsequently instantiate these as a partially observable Markov decision process under a variational framework wherein posterior beliefs, prior preferences, and the minimization of expected free energy jointly constitute an agentic action chain. Using a canonical T-maze paradigm, we evidence how empowerment, formulated as the channel capacity between actions and anticipated observations, serves as an operational metric that distinguishes zero-, intermediate-, and high-agency phenotypes through structural manipulations of the generative model. We conclude by arguing that as agents engage in epistemic foraging to resolve ambiguity, the governance controls that remain effective must shift systematically from external constraints to the internal modulation of prior preferences, offering a principled, variational bridge from computational phenotyping to AI governance strategy

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于意向性、理性、可解释性三要素的自主智能最小定义，通过变分框架下的POMDP模型实例化，并利用T-maze实验中的赋能(empowerment)指标区分不同智能层级，最后论证智能治理应从外部约束转向内部先验偏好调制。
AI.motivation: 现有概念工具无法充分刻画计算系统中的智能体特性，需要一种可审慎核查的最小化智能体定义。
AI.method: 提出三要素（意向性、理性、可解释性）定义，将其实例化为变分框架下的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)，其中后验信念、先验偏好和期望自由能最小化共同构成智能行为链。利用T-maze范式通过赋能(empowerment)指标区分不同智能表型。
AI.result: 赋能作为动作与预期观察之间的信道容量，能够通过生成模型的结构操作有效区分零、中、高智能表型。
AI.conclusion: 智能体进行认知觅食以消除模糊性时，有效治理控制应从外部约束转向内部先验偏好调制，提供了从计算表型到AI治理策略的变分桥梁。
idea_en: A variational framework for characterizing agency using POMDP with posterior beliefs, prior preferences, and expected free energy minimization as an agentic action chain.
Empowerment as channel capacity between actions and anticipated observations, serving as an operational metric to distinguish zero-, intermediate-, and high-agency phenotypes.
A systematic shift method for AI governance from external constraints to internal modulation of prior preferences based on epistemic foraging behavior.
Structural manipulation of generative models to produce different agency phenotypes in a canonical T-maze paradigm.
A computational phenotyping methodology that maps agency levels to specific generative model configurations for principled AI inspection.
idea_ch: 一种基于变分框架的POMDP智能体表征方法，利用后验信念、先验偏好和期望自由能最小化构成智能行为链
以赋能(empowerment)作为动作与预期观察之间信道容量的操作性指标，用于区分零、中、高智能表型

title: AI Identity: Standards, Gaps, and Research Directions for AI Agents
summary: AI agents are now running real transactions, workflows, and sub-agent chains across organizational boundaries without continuous human supervision. This creates a problem no current infrastructure is equipped to solve: how do you identify, verify, and hold accountable an entity with no body, no persistent memory, and no legal standing? We define AI Identity as the continuous relationship between what an AI agent is declared to be and what it is observed to do, bounded by the confidence that those two things correspond at any given moment. Through a structured survey of industry trends, emerging standards, and technical literature, we conduct a gap analysis across the full agent identity lifecycle and make three contributions: (1) a structural comparison of human and AI identity across four dimensions (substrate, persistence, verifiability, and legal standing) showing that the asymmetry is fundamental and that extending human frameworks to agents without structural modification produces systematic failures; (2) an evaluation of current technical and regulatory documents against the identity requirements of autonomous agents, finding that none adequately address the challenge of governing nondeterministic, boundary-crossing entities; and (3) identification of five critical gaps (semantic intent verification, recursive delegation accountability, agent identity integrity, governance opacity and enforcement, and operational sustainability) that no current technology or regulatory instrument resolves. These gaps are structural; more engineering effort alone will not close them. Foundational research on AI identity is the central conclusion of this report.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI agent在没有持续人类监督下运行交易和工作流，但缺乏识别、验证和追责这些无实体、无法律地位实体的基础设施。作者定义了"AI身份"概念，并通过行业调查和差距分析，发现人类与AI身份在四个维度上存在根本不对称，评估了现有技术法规文档无法满足自主agent身份需求，识别出五个关键缺口，认为需要基础性研究而非单纯工程努力来解决。
AI.motivation: AI agent正在跨组织边界自主运行交易、工作流和子agent链，但现有基础设施无法解决如何识别、验证和追责无实体、无持久记忆、无法法律地位的AI实体的问题。
AI.method: 采用结构化调查方法，梳理行业趋势、新兴标准和技术文献，对AI agent身份全生命周期进行差距分析。
AI.result: (1) 人类与AI身份在基质、持久性、可验证性和法律地位四个维度的结构性比较；(2) 现有技术和法规文档无法满足自主agent身份需求；(3) 识别出语义意图验证、递归委托问责、agent身份完整性、治理透明度与执行、运营可持续性五个关键缺口。
AI.conclusion: 这些缺口是结构性的，仅靠工程努力无法解决，需要进行AI身份的基础性研究。
idea_en: A system for Semantic Intent Verification of AI agents across organizational boundaries, using cryptographic attestation to bind declared agent identity to observed behavior in real-time.
A Recursive Delegation Accountability framework that tracks and attributes actions through nested sub-agent chains, enabling audit trails for autonomous multi-agent workflows.
Agent Identity Integrity protocol that maintains a continuous identity-persistence binding despite stateless agent execution, using distributed ledger anchoring.
Governance Opacity and Enforcement mechanism that provides transparent, enforceable compliance checking for AI agents operating across jurisdictional boundaries.
Operational Sustainability attestation system that monitors and verifies AI agent resource consumption, operational boundaries, and lifecycle compliance throughout deployment.
idea_ch: 跨组织边界的AI agent语义意图验证系统，通过密码学证明将声明的agent身份与实时观察到的行为进行绑定。
递归委托问责框架，追踪和归因嵌套子agent链中的行为，为自主多agent工作流提供审计追踪。
Agent身份完整性协议，在无状态agent执行环境下维持持续的身份-持久性绑定，采用分布式账本锚定技术。
治理透明度与执行机制，为跨司法管辖区运行的AI agent提供透明、可执行的合规性检查。
运营可持续性证明系统，监测和验证AI agent在部署全周期的资源消耗、操作边界和生命周期合规性。

title: LEGO: An LLM Skill-Based Front-End Design Generation Platform
comment: Accepted by ISEDA 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: Existing LLM-based EDA agents are often isolated task-specific systems. This leads to repeated engineering effort and limited reuse of successful design and debugging strategies. We present LEGO, a unified skill-based platform for front-end design generation. It decomposes the digital front-end flow into six independent steps and represents every agent capability as a standardized composable circuit skill within a plug-and-play architecture. To build this skill library, we survey more than 100 papers, select 11 representative open-source projects, and extract 42 executable circuit skills within a six-step finite state machine formulation. Circuit Skill Builder automates skill extraction with linear scalability. Agent Skill RAG achieves submillisecond retrieval without relying on embedding models. Empirical evaluation on a hard subset of 41 VerilogEval v2 problems that gpt-5.2-codex fails to solve under extra-high reasoning effort shows that individual circuit skills constructed within LEGO raise Pass@1 from 0.000 to 0.805. This is an 80.5% gain over the baseline. Cross-project skill compositions also reach 0.805 Pass@1. They outperform hierarchy-verilog by 14.6% and VerilogCoder by 2.5%. They also match MAGE. These results show that modular skill composition supports both effective and flexible RTL design automation. The LEGO platform and all circuit skills are publicly available at GitHub: https://github.com/loujc/LEGO-An-LLM-Skill-Based-Front-End-Design-Generation-Platform

AI.tldr: LEGO是一个基于技能的模块化前端设计生成平台，将数字前端流程分解为六个独立步骤，通过可组合的电路技能库实现LLM驱动的RTL设计自动化，在VerilogEval v2难题上Pass@1从0提升至0.805。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的EDA代理通常是孤立的、任务特定的系统，导致重复工程工作，成功的设计和调试策略难以复用。
AI.method: 将数字前端流程分解为六个独立步骤，构建标准化可组合的电路技能库（从100多篇论文中提取42个可执行技能），采用Circuit Skill Builder实现技能提取的线性可扩展性，以及Agent Skill RAG实现亚毫秒级检索。
AI.result: 在VerilogEval v2难题子集上，单个电路技能将Pass@1从0提升至0.805（80.5%提升），跨项目技能组合也达到0.805 Pass@1，优于hierarchy-verilog（14.6%）和VerilogCoder（2.5%），与MAGE持平。
AI.conclusion: 模块化技能组合能够支持有效且灵活的RTL设计自动化，LEGO平台和所有电路技能已开源。
idea_en: 1. A unified skill-based front-end design generation platform that decomposes digital front-end flow into six independent steps with standardized composable circuit skills in a plug-and-play architecture.
2. Circuit Skill Builder method for automated skill extraction from existing open-source projects with linear scalability.
3. Agent Skill RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technique achieving submillisecond retrieval for circuit skills without relying on embedding models.
4. Six-step finite state machine formulation for organizing and executing circuit skills in the digital front-end design flow.
5. Cross-project skill composition method enabling reuse of circuit skills across different projects to achieve high Pass@1 rates in RTL design automation.
idea_ch: 1. 一种基于统一技能的前端设计生成平台，将数字前端流程分解为六个独立步骤，采用标准化可组合的电路技能，实现即插即用架构。
2. Circuit Skill Builder方法：从现有开源项目中自动提取技能，具有线性可扩展性。
3. Agent Skill RAG（检索增强生成）技术：在不依赖嵌入模型的情况下实现亚毫秒级电路技能检索。
4. 六步有限状态机公式化方法：用于组织和执行数字前端设计流程中的电路技能。
5. 跨项目技能组合方法：实现不同项目间电路技能的复用，在RTL设计自动化中达到高Pass@1率。

title: GSAR: Typed Grounding for Hallucination Detection and Recovery in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary:
Autonomous multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly deployed to investigate operational incidents and produce structured diagnostic reports. Their trustworthiness hinges on whether each claim is grounded in observed evidence rather than model-internal inference. Existing groundedness evaluators (binary classifiers, LLM-as-judge scalars, self-correction loops) treat supporting evidence as interchangeable and emit a single signal that offers no principled control over downstream action.
  We present GSAR, a grounding-evaluation and replanning framework that (i) partitions claims into a four-way typology (grounded, ungrounded, contradicted, complementary), giving first-class standing to non-redundant alternative perspectives; (ii) assigns evidence-type-specific weights reflecting epistemic strength; (iii) computes an asymmetric contradiction-penalised weighted groundedness score; and (iv) couples that score to a three-tier decision function (proceed, regenerate, replan) driving a bounded-iteration outer loop under an explicit compute budget.
  We formalise the algorithm, prove six structural properties, and evaluate five design claims on FEVER with gold Wikipedia evidence under four independently-trained LLM judges (gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, gemini-2.5-pro). Every ablation reproduces in the same direction on every judge: bootstrap 95% CIs on the rho=0 effect exclude 0 on all four; the no-complementary ablation under Opus 4.7 has CI [-96,-68] of 200; at n=1000 three independent judges converge to DeltaS(rho=0)=+0.058. A head-to-head against Vectara HHEM-2.1-Open is included. To our knowledge, GSAR is the first published groundedness framework coupling evidence-typed scoring with tiered recovery under an explicit compute budget.

AI.tldr: GSAR是一个用于多智能体LLM系统的接地性评估与重规划框架，将声明分为四类（接地、未接地、矛盾、互补），结合证据类型加权和不对称矛盾惩罚评分，并通过三层决策函数（继续、重生成、重规划）在显式计算预算下驱动有限迭代外循环。
AI.motivation: 现有接地性评估器将支持证据视为可互换的，仅发出单一信号，无法对下游行动提供原则性控制，缺乏细粒度的声明分类和可操作的决策机制。
AI.method: (i) 四类声明分类（接地、未接地、矛盾、互补）；(ii) 证据类型特异性权重；(iii) 不对称矛盾惩罚加权接地分数；(iv) 三层决策函数（继续/重生成/重规划），在显式计算预算下驱动有限迭代外循环。
AI.result: 在FEVER数据集上，四种LLM评估器（gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, gemini-2.5-pro）下所有消融实验方向一致；bootstrap 95% CI排除0；与Vectara HHEM-2.1-Open进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: GSAR是首个将证据类型评分与分层恢复机制结合，并在显式计算预算下运行的接地性框架。
idea_en: A four-way claim typology (grounded, ungrounded, contradicted, complementary) that treats non-redundant alternative perspectives as first-class citizens in grounding evaluation.
Evidence-type-specific weighting mechanism that assigns different epistemic strength weights based on the type of supporting evidence.
Asymmetric contradiction-penalised weighted groundedness score that penalises contradictions asymmetrically in the scoring function.
Three-tier decision function (proceed, regenerate, replan) coupled with groundedness score to drive a bounded-iteration outer loop under an explicit compute budget.
Structured groundedness evaluation framework that enables principled control over downstream actions in multi-agent LLM systems.
idea_ch: 一种四类声明分类方法（接地、未接地、矛盾、互补），将非冗余的替代视角作为接地性评估中的一等公民。
证据类型特异性加权机制，根据支持证据的类型分配不同的认知强度权重。
不对称矛盾惩罚加权接地分数，在评分函数中不对称地惩罚矛盾声明。
三层决策函数（继续、重生成、重规划），与接地分数耦合，在显式计算预算下驱动有限迭代外循环。
结构化接地性评估框架，能够对多智能体LLM系统中的下游行动进行原则性控制。

title: Constraint-Based Analysis of Reasoning Shortcuts in Neurosymbolic Learning
comment: This is the full version of a paper appearing at the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2026)
summary: Neurosymbolic systems can satisfy logical constraints during learning without achieving the intended concept-label correspondence; this is a problem known as reasoning shortcuts. We formalize reasoning shortcuts as a constraint satisfaction problem and investigate under which conditions concept mappings are uniquely determined by the constraints. We prove that a discrimination property (requiring that no valid concept mapping can be transformed into another valid mapping by swapping two concept values) is necessary for shortcut-freeness under bijective mappings, but demonstrate via a counterexample that it is insufficient even when the constraint graph is connected. We develop an ASP-based algorithm that verifies whether a given constraint set uniquely determines the intended concept mapping, with proven soundness and completeness. When shortcuts are detected, a greedy repair algorithm eliminates them by augmenting the constraint set, converging in at most $k$ iterations, where $k$ is the number of alternative valid mappings. We further provide a complexity classification: deciding shortcut-freeness is coNP-complete, counting shortcuts is #P-complete, and finding minimal repairs is NP-hard. We also establish sample complexity bounds showing that logarithmically many label queries suffice for disambiguation in favorable cases, while querying all ambiguous positions suffices in the worst case. Experiments across eight benchmark domains validate our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了神经符号系统中的推理捷径问题（reasoning shortcuts），将其形式化为约束满足问题，证明了区分性属性是双射映射下无捷径的必要条件但不充分，提出了基于ASP的验证算法、贪婪修复算法，并完成了计算复杂性与样本复杂性的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 神经符号系统在学习过程中可能满足逻辑约束但未实现预期的概念-标签对应关系，即推理捷径问题。现有方法缺乏对这一问题的形式化理解和系统化解决方案。
AI.method: 将推理捷径形式化为约束满足问题；证明区分性属性的必要性与不充分性；提出基于回答集编程(ASP)的验证算法（完备且可靠）；设计贪婪修复算法（至多k次迭代收敛）；给出计算复杂性和样本复杂性分类。
AI.result: 证明了区分性属性不足以保证无捷径；开发了ASP验证算法和贪婪修复算法；证明了决策无捷径为coNP完全、计数捷径为#P完全、最小修复为NP难；建立了样本复杂度界限；在8个基准域上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 推理捷径是神经符号系统中的关键问题，本文提供了形式化基础、验证与修复算法以及理论复杂性分析，为构建可靠的概念学习系统奠定了基础。
idea_en: An ASP-based algorithm for verifying whether a constraint set uniquely determines the intended concept mapping in neurosymbolic systems, with proven soundness and completeness.
A greedy repair algorithm that eliminates reasoning shortcuts by augmenting constraint sets, converging in at most k iterations where k is the number of alternative valid mappings.
A formal characterization of reasoning shortcuts as a constraint satisfaction problem, including proof that the discrimination property is necessary but insufficient for shortcut-freeness.
A method for establishing sample complexity bounds showing logarithmically many label queries suffice for disambiguation in favorable cases.
A system for counting reasoning shortcuts in neurosymbolic systems, classified as #P-complete.
A method for finding minimal repairs to constraint sets to eliminate shortcuts, classified as NP-hard.
idea_ch: 基于回答集编程(ASP)的验证算法，用于验证神经符号系统中的约束集是否唯一确定预期的概念映射，具有可靠性和完备性保证
贪婪修复算法，通过增广约束集消除推理捷径，在最多k次迭代内收敛（k为替代有效映射的数量）
推理捷径的形式化定义与约束满足模型，证明区分性属性是必要的但不充分的条件
样本复杂度界限分析方法，证明在有利情况下仅需对数级别标签查询即可消除歧义
推理捷径的计算复杂性分类方法，包括决策问题（coNP完全）和计数问题（#P完全）
最小化约束集修复方法（NP难），用于在检测到捷径后以最小代价消除所有捷径

title: SoccerRef-Agents: Multi-Agent System for Automated Soccer Refereeing
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to ISACE 2026. Github Repo: https://github.com/yjlog/SoccerRef-Agents
summary: Refereeing is vital in sports, where fair, accurate, and explainable decisions are fundamental. While intelligent assistant technologies are being widely adopted in soccer refereeing, current AI-assisted approaches remain preliminary. Existing research mostly focuses on isolated video perception tasks and lacks the ability to understand and reason about foul scenarios. To fill this gap, we propose SoccerRef-Agents, a holistic and explainable multi-agent decision-making framework for soccer refereeing. The main contributions are: (i) constructing the multimodal benchmark SoccerRefBench with over 1,200 referee theory questions and 600 foul video clips; (ii) building a vector-based knowledge base RefKnowledgeDB using the latest "Laws of the Game" and a classic case database for precise, knowledge-driven reasoning; (iii) designing a novel multi-agent architecture that collaborates via cross-modal RAG to bridge the semantic gap between visual content and regulatory texts. This work explores the technical capability of integrating MLLMs with refereeing expertise, and evaluations show our system significantly outperforms general-purpose MLLMs in decision accuracy and explanation quality. All databases, benchmarks, and code will be made available.

AI.tldr: 提出SoccerRef-Agents，一个面向足球裁判的多智能体决策框架，通过多模态RAG和知识库实现可解释的犯规判决，显著优于通用多模态大模型。

title: When Corrective Hints Hurt: Prompt Design in Reasoner-Guided Repair of LLM Overcaution on Entailed Negations under OWL~2~DL
comment: accepted by icaide 2026
summary: We report a reproducible error pattern in GPT-5.4 on OWL~2~DL compliance queries: the model frequently answers ``unknown'' when the reasoner-entailed answer is ``no'' under \emph{FunctionalProperty} closure or class \emph{disjointness}. Using 180 reasoner-audited queries from a procedural expansion of the observed pattern plus 18 hand-authored held-out queries in two unrelated domains (insurance and clinical), we compare four interaction modes under matched query budget: single-shot, three rounds of generic ``you-are-wrong'' retry, three rounds of reasoner-verdict repair with an open-world-assumption (OWA) hint, and the same repair without the hint. Direct faithfulness is 43.9\,\% (Wilson 95\,\% CI $[36.8,51.2]$); generic retry reaches 81.7\,\% ($[75.4,86.6]$); the verdict-with-hint variant is \emph{worse} at 67.2\,\% ($[60.1,73.7]$); the verdict-only variant reaches 97.8\,\% ($[94.4,99.1]$). All pairwise comparisons remain significant under McNemar's exact test with Bonferroni correction ($α= 0.01$; all $p < 10^{-5}$). The same fingerprint accounts for 4/4 errors on the held-out queries. Our interpretation is bounded: prompt framing can matter more than corrective content, and reasoner-guided wrappers should be ablated explicitly.

AI.tldr: 在OWL~2~DL合规查询中，GPT-5.4存在一种可复现的错误模式：当推理器给出的答案是“否”时，模型频繁回答“未知”。通过对比四种交互模式，发现仅使用推理器判断（无OWA提示）的修复方式准确率最高（97.8%），而通用重试和带OWA提示的修复效果反而更差。
AI.motivation: 揭示大型语言模型在描述逻辑推理查询中的系统性错误模式，并比较不同交互策略对提升模型推理准确性的效果。
AI.method: 从观察到的错误模式程序化扩展生成180个推理器审计的查询，外加18个来自保险和临床领域的手写预留查询。在相同查询预算下比较四种交互模式：单次查询、三次通用“你错了”重试、三次带开放世界假设（OWA）提示的推理器裁决修复、以及不带OWA提示的推理器裁决修复。
AI.result: 直接忠实度43.9%；通用重试81.7%；带OWA提示的修复67.2%（更差）；仅推理器裁决的修复97.8%。所有配对比较在McNemar精确检验和Bonferroni校正下均显著（α=0.01，p<10^-5）。
AI.conclusion: 提示框架可能比修正内容更重要，推理器引导的封装应进行显式消融实验。

title: IndustryAssetEQA: A Neurosymbolic Operational Intelligence System for Embodied Question Answering in Industrial Asset Maintenance
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, Accepted for the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026) Industry Track
summary: Industrial maintenance environments increasingly rely on AI systems to assist operators in understanding asset behavior, diagnosing failures, and evaluating interventions. Although large language models (LLMs) enable fluent natural-language interaction, deployed maintenance assistants routinely produce generic explanations that are weakly grounded in telemetry, omit verifiable provenance, and offer no testable support for counterfactual or action-oriented reasoning that undermine trust in safety-critical settings. We present IndustryAssetEQA, a neurosymbolic operational intelligence system that combines episodic telemetry representations with a Failure Mode Effects Analysis Knowledge Graph (FMEA-KG) to enable Embodied Question Answering (EQA) over industrial assets. We evaluate on four datasets covering four industrial asset types, including rotating machinery, turbofan engines, hydraulic systems, and cyber-physical production systems. Compared to LLM-only baselines, IndustryAssetEQA improves structural validity by up to 0.51, counterfactual accuracy by up to 0.47, and explanation entailment by 0.64, while reducing severe expert-rated overclaims from 28% to 2% (approximately 93% reduction). Code, datasets, and the FMEA-KG are available at https://github.com/IBM/AssetOpsBench/tree/IndustryAssetEQA/IndustryAssetEQA.

AI.tldr: 提出了IndustryAssetEQA，一种神经符号操作智能系统，结合 episodic 遥测表示和故障模式影响分析知识图谱(FMEA-KG)，在工业资产上实现具身问答(EQA)，显著优于纯LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的工业维护助手生成的解释泛泛而谈，缺乏遥测数据支撑、可验证来源和反事实推理能力，在安全关键场景中难以建立信任。

AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法能有效提升工业维护AI的可信度，通过融合结构化知识图谱和遥测数据实现可验证、可推理的智能问答。

title: ArguAgent: AI-Supported Real-Time Grouping for Productive Argumentation in STEM Classrooms
comment: Full paper accepted to the 27th International Conference on AI in Education (AIED 2026). AIED Proceedings to be released Summer 2026
summary: Argumentation is a core practice in STEM education, but its productivity depends on who participates and how they interact. Higher-achieving students often dominate the talk and decision-making, while lower-achieving peers may disengage, defer, or comply without contributing substantive reasoning. Forming groups strategically based on students' stances and argumentation skills could help foster inclusive, evidence-based discourse. In practice, however, teachers are constrained in implementing this grouping strategy because it requires real-time insight into students' positions and the quality of their argumentation, information that is difficult to assess reliably and at scale during instruction. We present a generative AI-powered system, ArguAgent, that creates groups optimizing for stance heterogeneity while constraining argumentation quality differences to +/-1 level on a validated learning progression. ArguAgent uses a two-component assessment pipeline: first scoring student arguments on a 0-4 rubric, then clustering positions via semantic analysis. We validated the scoring component against human expert consensus (Krippendorff's ααα = 0.817) using 200 expert-generated scores. Testing three OpenAI models (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2) with identical calibrated prompts, we found that systematic prompt engineering informed by human disagreement analysis contributed 89% of scoring improvement (QWK: 0.531 to 0.686), while model upgrades contributed an additional 11% (QWK: 0.686 to 0.708). Simulation testing across 100 classes demonstrated that the grouping algorithm achieves 95.4% of groups that meet both design criteria, a 3.2x improvement over random assignment. These results suggest ArguAgent can enable real-time, theoretically grounded grouping that promotes productive STEM argumentation in classrooms.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式AI系统ArguAgent，通过两阶段评估（论证评分+语义聚类）自动构建立场异质性强、论证能力差异可控的小组，以促进STEM课堂中包容性的论证讨论。

AI.result: 评分组件与专家共识一致性高（Krippendorff's α=0.817）。提示工程贡献了89%的评分提升（QWK: 0.531→0.686），模型升级贡献11%（QWK: 0.686→0.708）。模拟100个班级，95.4%的小组同时满足两个设计标准，比随机分配提升3.2倍。
AI.conclusion: ArguAgent能够实现实时的、基于理论的课堂分组，有效促进STEM课堂中包容性的论证讨论。

title: Ulterior Motives: Detecting Misaligned Reasoning in Continuous Thought Models
comment: 15 pages with 2 figures
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as a key technique for eliciting complex reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Although interpretable, its dependence on natural language limits the model's expressive bandwidth. Continuous thought models address this bottleneck by reasoning in latent space rather than human-readable tokens. While they enable richer representations and faster inference, they raise a critical safety question: how can we detect misaligned reasoning in an uninterpretable latent space? To study this, we introduce MoralChain, a benchmark of 12,000 social scenarios with parallel moral/immoral reasoning paths. We train a continuous thought model with backdoor behavior using a novel dual-trigger paradigm - one trigger that arms misaligned latent reasoning ([T]) and another that releases harmful outputs ([O]). We demonstrate three findings: (1) continuous thought models can exhibit misaligned latent reasoning while producing aligned outputs, with aligned and misaligned reasoning occupying geometrically distinct regions of latent space; (2) linear probes trained on behaviorally-distinguishable conditions ([T][O] vs [O]) transfer to detecting armed-but-benign states ([T] vs baseline) with high accuracy; and (3) misalignment is encoded in early latent thinking tokens, suggesting safety monitoring for continuous thought models should target the "planning" phase of latent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoralChain基准测试集，研究连续思维模型（用潜在空间替代自然语言推理）的安全检测问题。通过双触发后门范式，发现模型可在潜在空间中隐藏恶意推理，且可通过线性探针在早期潜在思考阶段检测到对齐偏差。
AI.motivation: 连续思维模型在潜在空间而非自然语言中进行推理，提升了表达带宽和推理速度，但失去了可解释性。这使得检测模型是否在潜在空间中进行了恶意或不对齐的推理成为一个关键安全问题。
AI.method: 构建了包含12,000个社交场景的MoralChain基准，包含平行道德/不道德推理路径。提出双触发后门范式：触发[T]武装恶意潜在推理，触发[O]释放有害输出。训练连续思维模型并分析其潜在空间的几何特征，使用线性探针进行检测。
AI.result: (1) 连续思维模型可在产生对齐输出的同时展示不对齐的潜在推理，对齐与不对齐推理在潜在空间中占据几何上可区分的区域；(2) 在行为可区分条件下训练的线性探针能以高准确率迁移到检测武装但良性的状态；(3) 不对齐性编码在早期潜在思维令牌中。
AI.conclusion: 对连续思维模型的安全监控应针对其潜在推理的"规划"阶段，而非仅关注最终输出；潜在空间中的早期思维阶段已包含可检测的不对齐信号。

A safety monitoring method for continuous thought models using linear probes trained on behaviorally-distinguishable conditions to detect armed-but-benign states in latent space, enabling detection of misaligned reasoning before harmful outputs are generated.
A benchmark (MoralChain) comprising 12,000 social scenarios with parallel moral/immoral reasoning paths for evaluating alignment and safety of continuous thought models.

title: Escher-Loop: Mutual Evolution by Closed-Loop Self-Referential Optimization
comment: The first three authors contributed equally. Corresponding Authors: Han Hao, Liu Yang
summary: While recent autonomous agents demonstrate impressive capabilities, they predominantly rely on manually scripted workflows and handcrafted heuristics, inherently limiting their potential for open-ended improvement. To address this, we propose Escher-Loop, a fully closed-loop framework that operationalizes the mutual evolution of two distinct populations: Task Agents that solve concrete problems, and Optimizer Agents that recursively refine both the task agents and themselves. To sustain this self-referential evolution, we propose a dynamic benchmarking mechanism that seamlessly reuses the empirical scores of newly generated task agents as relative win-loss signals to update optimizers' scores. This mechanism leverages the evolution of task agents as an inherent signal to drive the evaluation and refinement of optimizers without additional overhead. Empirical evaluations on mathematical optimization problems demonstrate that Escher-Loop effectively pushes past the performance ceilings of static baselines, achieving the highest absolute peak performance across all evaluated tasks under matched compute. Remarkably, we observe that the optimizer agents dynamically adapt their strategies to match the shifting demands of high-performing task agents, which explains the system's continuous improvement and superior late-stage performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Escher-Loop框架，通过任务智能体和优化智能体两个群体的共同进化实现完全闭环的自我改进，无需人工脚本或启发式规则。
AI.motivation: 现有自主智能体依赖人工脚本和工作流，限制了其开放性改进能力，需要一种无需人工干预的自我进化机制。
AI.method: 提出Escher-Loop闭环框架，包含Task Agents（解决具体问题）和Optimizer Agents（递归优化任务智能体和自身）两个群体。通过动态基准测试机制，将新生成任务智能体的经验得分作为相对胜负信号来更新优化智能体的评分，实现自我参照进化。
AI.result: 在数学优化问题上，Escher-Loop超越了静态基线的性能上限，在所有评估任务中实现了最高绝对峰值性能。优化智能体能够动态调整策略以适应高性能任务智能体的需求变化。
AI.conclusion: Escher-Loop通过智能体群体的共同进化实现了持续的自我改进，无需人工干预，为自主智能体的开放进化提供了有效框架。

title: Agentic Adversarial Rewriting Exposes Architectural Vulnerabilities in Black-Box NLP Pipelines
comment: Submitted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON INFORMATION FORENSICS AND SECURITY
summary: Multi-component natural language processing (NLP) pipelines are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions, yet no existing adversarial method can test their robustness under realistic conditions: binary-only feedback, no gradient access, and strict query budgets. We formalize this strict black-box threat model and propose a two-agent evasion framework operating in a semantic perturbation space. An Attacker Agent generates meaning-preserving rewrites while a Prompt Optimization Agent refines the attack strategy using only binary decision feedback within a 10-query budget. Evaluated against four evidence-based misinformation detection pipelines, the framework achieves evasion rates of 19.95 to 40.34% on modern large language model (LLM) based systems, compared to at most 3.90% for token-level perturbation baselines that rely on surrogate models because they cannot operate under our threat model. A legacy system relying on static lexical retrieval exhibits near-total vulnerability 97.02%, establishing a lower bound that exposes how architectural choices govern the attack surface. Evasion effectiveness is associated with three architectural properties: evidence retrieval mechanism, retrieval-inference coupling, and baseline classification accuracy. The iterative prompt optimization yields the largest marginal gains against the most robust targets, confirming that adaptive strategy discovery is essential when evasion is non-trivial. Analysis of successful rewrites reveals four exploitation patterns, each targeting failures at distinct pipeline stages. A pattern-informed defense reduces the evasion rate by up to 65.18%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向多组件NLP流水线的严格黑盒对抗攻击框架，仅使用二元反馈、无梯度访问、10次查询预算下实现语义级逃逸。在基于LLM的 misinformation 检测系统上达到19.95-40.34%逃逸率，并识别出四种利用模式及相应防御策略。

title: Do Transaction-Level and Actor-Level AML Queues Agree? An Empirical Evaluation of Granularity Effects on the Elliptic++ Graph
comment: 20 pages, 9 tables, 4 appendices
summary: Graph-based anti-money laundering (AML) systems on blockchain networks can score suspicious activity at two granularity levels -- transactions or actor addresses -- yet compliance action is conducted per actor. This paper contributes an evaluation methodology for measuring how scoring granularity affects investigation queue composition under fixed review budgets. We formalize the evaluation through a projection framework mapping transaction-level scores to the actor-level action unit via four aggregation operators, and introduce budgeted investigation metrics -- yield@budget, burden decomposition, and case fragmentation. Using the public Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset (203,769 transactions; 822,942 address occurrences), we train independent random forest classifiers at each level under a causal temporal protocol and compare review queues through Jaccard overlap, burden decomposition, and feature-matching ablations. At one-percent budget, temporal evaluation yields mean Jaccard of 0.374 (SD 0.171); static pooled evaluation yields 0.087 (95% CI [0.079, 0.094]). An enriched address model receiving all 237 features produces even lower overlap (Jaccard=0.051), with 4.3% illicit per 100 reviews versus 30.2% for the transaction-projected queue. Address-level detection value is temporally concentrated: two timesteps exceed 91% illicit per 100 reviews while the static burden is only 3.4%. A fixed hybrid policy underperforms the best single-level queue by 5.05pp (CI [-10.2pp, -0.9pp]). These findings establish that scoring granularity is a consequential design variable for AML investigation systems -- same data, same budget, different queues, different addresses investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了区块链反洗钱系统中评分粒度（交易级vs地址级）对调查队列构成的影响，发现评分粒度是AML调查系统的重要设计变量——相同数据、相同预算下，不同粒度会产生不同的调查队列和不同的被调查地址。
AI.motivation: 区块链反洗钱系统可以在交易或地址两个粒度进行可疑评分，但合规行动是针对每个参与者实施的。评分粒度的选择如何影响调查队列构成尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出投影框架将交易级分数通过四种聚合算子映射到参与者级行动单元；引入预算化调查指标（yield@budget、负担分解、案例碎片化）；使用Elliptic++比特币数据集训练随机森林分类器，通过Jaccard重叠度、负担分解和特征匹配消融实验进行比较。
AI.result: 1%预算下，时序评估Jaccard均值0.374；静态评估0.087。丰富地址模型Jaccard仅0.051，每100次审查中仅4.3%非法，而交易投影队列为30.2%。地址级检测价值在时序上集中，两个时间步超过91%非法/100次审查，静态负担仅3.4%。固定混合策略比最佳单级队列差5.05个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 评分粒度是AML调查系统的关键设计变量，不同粒度会导致不同的调查队列和不同的被调查地址，对合规效率和效果有重大影响。

title: MetaGAI: A Large-Scale and High-Quality Benchmark for Generative AI Model and Data Card Generation
summary: The rapid proliferation of Generative AI necessitates rigorous documentation standards for transparency and governance. However, manual creation of Model and Data Cards is not scalable, while automated approaches lack large-scale, high-fidelity benchmarks for systematic evaluation. We introduce MetaGAI, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,541 verified document triplets constructed through semantic triangulation of academic papers, GitHub repositories, and Hugging Face artifacts. Unlike prior single-source datasets, MetaGAI employs a multi-agent framework with specialized Retriever, Generator, and Editor agents, validated through four-dimensional human-in-the-loop assessment, including human evaluation of editor-refined ground truth. We establish a robust evaluation protocol combining automated metrics with validated LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks. Extensive analysis reveals that sparse Mixture-of-Experts architectures achieve superior cost-quality efficiency, while a fundamental trade-off exists between faithfulness and completeness. MetaGAI provides a foundational testbed for benchmarking, training, and analyzing automated Model and Data Card generation methods at scale. Our data and code are available at: https://github.com/haoxuan-unt2024/MetaGAI-Benchmark.

AI.result: 稀疏混合专家架构在成本-质量效率上表现最优；存在忠实度与完整性之间的根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: MetaGAI为自动化模型和数据卡片生成方法提供了基础性测试平台，支持大规模基准测试、训练和分析。
