title: FinGround: Detecting and Grounding Financial Hallucinations via Atomic Claim Verification
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Industry Track. 14 pages, 1 figure, 14 tables
summary: Financial AI systems must produce answers grounded in specific regulatory filings, yet current LLMs fabricate metrics, invent citations, and miscalculate derived quantities. These errors carry direct regulatory consequences as the EU AI Act's high-risk enforcement deadline approaches (August 2026). Existing hallucination detectors treat all claims uniformly, missing 43% of computational errors that require arithmetic re-verification against structured tables. We present FinGround, a three-stage verify-then-ground pipeline for financial document QA. Stage 1 performs finance-aware hybrid retrieval over text and tables. Stage 2 decomposes answers into atomic claims classified by a six-type financial taxonomy and verified with type-routed strategies including formula reconstruction. Stage 3 rewrites unsupported claims with paragraph- and table-cell-level citations. To cleanly isolate verification value from retrieval quality, we propose retrieval-equalized evaluation as standard methodology for RAG verification research: when all systems receive identical retrieval, FinGround still reduces hallucination rates by 68% over the strongest baseline ($p < 0.01$). The full pipeline achieves a 78% reduction relative to GPT-4o. An 8B distilled detector retains 91.4% F1 at 18x lower per-claim latency, enabling $0.003/query deployment, supported by qualitative signals from a four-week analyst pilot.

AI.tldr: FinGround是一个面向金融文档问答的三阶段验证-溯源管线，通过金融感知混合检索、六类财务声明分类验证及带引用的重写机制，将幻觉率降低78%（相对GPT-4o），并提出了检索均衡评估方法论。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在金融监管文档问答中频繁编造指标、捏造引用、计算错误，且现有幻觉检测器对所有声明统一处理，忽略了43%需要算术复核的计算错误。随着EU AI Act高风险管理截止日期（2026年8月）临近，亟需专门面向金融领域的验证与溯源方案。
AI.method: 三阶段管线：(1) 金融感知混合检索，同时检索文本和表格；(2) 将答案分解为原子声明，按六类财务分类法分类，并用类型路由策略（包括公式重建）进行验证；(3) 用段落和表格单元级引用重写不支持的声明。同时提出检索均衡评估方法，以隔离验证价值。
AI.result: 在检索均衡条件下，FinGround相比最强基线降低68%幻觉率（p<0.01）；完整管线相比GPT-4o降低78%幻觉率；蒸馏的8B检测器在18倍更低延迟下保持91.4% F1，部署成本$0.003/查询。
AI.conclusion: 专门面向金融文档的结构化验证-溯源方法能显著降低LLM幻觉，类型路由策略有效处理计算误差，蒸馏模型可在保持高精度同时大幅降低成本，为EU AI Act合规提供可行方案。

title: When AI reviews science: Can we trust the referee?
summary: The volume of scientific submissions continues to climb, outpacing the capacity of qualified human referees and stretching editorial timelines. At the same time, modern large language models (LLMs) offer impressive capabilities in summarization, fact checking, and literature triage, making the integration of AI into peer review increasingly attractive -- and, in practice, unavoidable. Yet early deployments and informal adoption have exposed acute failure modes. Recent incidents have revealed that hidden prompt injections embedded in manuscripts can steer LLM-generated reviews toward unjustifiably positive judgments. Complementary studies have also demonstrated brittleness to adversarial phrasing, authority and length biases, and hallucinated claims. These episodes raise a central question for scholarly communication: when AI reviews science, can we trust the AI referee? This paper provides a security- and reliability-centered analysis of AI peer review. We map attacks across the review lifecycle -- training and data retrieval, desk review, deep review, rebuttal, and system-level. We instantiate this taxonomy with four treatment-control probes on a stratified set of ICLR 2025 submissions, using two advanced LLM-based referees to isolate the causal effects of prestige framing, assertion strength, rebuttal sycophancy, and contextual poisoning on review scores. Together, this taxonomy and experimental audit provide an evidence-based baseline for assessing and tracking the reliability of AI peer review and highlight concrete failure points to guide targeted, testable mitigations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了AI在同行评议中的安全性和可靠性问题，构建了攻击分类体系，并通过实验验证了多项攻击手段对AI评审结果的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着科学投稿量激增，人工审稿资源不足，LLM被引入同行评议，但已暴露出提示注入、对抗性措辞、偏见和幻觉等严重问题，威胁学术评审的可信度。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖培训/数据检索、初审、深度审稿、反驳和系统层面的攻击分类体系；在ICLR 2025投稿上设计四个治疗-对照探针实验，使用两个先进LLM评审器，隔离分析声望框架、断言强度、反驳谄媚和上下文投毒对评审分数的因果效应。
AI.result: 实验量化了不同攻击方式对AI评审分数的显著影响，揭示了AI评审系统的脆弱性，建立了评估可信度的证据基线。
AI.conclusion: AI同行评议存在严重安全隐患，需要有针对性的可测试缓解措施；本文的分类体系和实验审计为跟踪和改进AI审稿可靠性提供了基础。

title: Thinking Like a Clinician: A Cognitive AI Agent for Clinical Diagnosis via Panoramic Profiling and Adversarial Debate
summary: The application of large language models (LLMs) in clinical decision support faces significant challenges of "tunnel vision" and diagnostic hallucinations present in their processing unstructured electronic health records (EHRs). To address these challenges, we propose a novel chain-based clinical reasoning framework, called DxChain, which transforms the diagnostic workflow into an iterative process by mirroring a clinician's cognitive trajectory that consists of "Memory Anchoring", "Navigation" and "Verification" phases. DxChain introduces three key methodological innovations to elicit the potential of LLM: (i) a Profile-Then-Plan paradigm to mitigate cold-start hallucinations by establishing a panoramic patient baseline, (ii) a Medical Tree-of-Thoughts (Med-ToT) algorithm for strategic look ahead planning and resource aware navigation, and (iii) a Dialectical Diagnostic Verification procedure utilizing "Angel-Devil" adversarial debates to resolve complex evidence conflicts. Evaluated on two real world benchmarks, MIMIC-IV-Ext Cardiac Disease and MIMIC-IV-Ext CDM, DxChain achieves state-of-the-art performances in both diagnostic accuracy and logical consistency, offering a modular and reliable architecture for next-generation clinical AI. The code is at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Dx-Chain.

AI.method: 提出DxChain框架，包含三个核心创新：(i) Profile-Then-Plan范式——建立全景患者基线以缓解冷启动幻觉；(ii) 医学思维树(Med-ToT)算法——战略性前瞻规划和资源感知导航；(iii) 辩证诊断验证过程——利用"天使-恶魔"对抗辩论解决复杂证据冲突。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV-Ext Cardiac Disease和MIMIC-IV-Ext CDM两个真实世界基准测试上，诊断准确性和逻辑一致性均取得最优结果。
AI.conclusion: DxChain为下一代临床AI提供了一种模块化且可靠的架构，有效提升了LLM在临床决策支持中的表现。

title: Tandem: Riding Together with Large and Small Language Models for Efficient Reasoning
comment: ACL 2026 Findings
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have catalyzed the rise of reasoning-intensive inference paradigms, where models perform explicit step-by-step reasoning before generating final answers. While such approaches improve answer quality and interpretability, they incur substantial computational overhead due to the prolonged generation sequences. In this paper, we propose Tandem, a novel collaborative framework that synergizes large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs) to achieve high-quality reasoning with significantly reduced computational cost. Specifically, the LLM serves as a strategic coordinator, efficiently generating a compact set of critical reasoning insights. These insights are then used to guide a smaller, more efficient SLM in executing the full reasoning process and delivering the final response. To balance efficiency and reliability, Tandem introduces a cost-aware termination mechanism that adaptively determines when sufficient reasoning guidance has been accumulated, enabling early stopping of the LLM's generation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that Tandem reduces computational costs by approximately 40% compared to standalone LLM reasoning, while achieving superior or competitive performance. Furthermore, the sufficiency classifier trained on one domain transfers effectively to others without retraining. The code is available at: https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_Tandem.

AI.tldr: Tandem是一个协同框架，通过让大语言模型(LLM)生成少量关键推理线索，再让小语言模型(SLM)执行完整推理，并引入成本感知终止机制，在保持推理质量的同时降低约40%计算成本。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在推理密集型任务中采用逐步推理范式，虽然提升了回答质量和可解释性，但生成长序列导致计算开销巨大，需要更高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出Tandem协作框架：LLM作为战略协调者生成紧凑的关键推理线索，SLM基于这些线索执行完整推理并生成最终回答。引入成本感知终止机制，自适应判断何时积累足够推理指导，实现LLM的提前停止。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，相比独立LLM推理，Tandem降低约40%计算成本，同时达到更优或具有竞争力的性能。训练的充分性分类器可在领域间零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: Tandem通过大小模型协同和自适应终止机制，在推理质量与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，且具有良好的跨领域迁移能力。
idea_en: A collaborative inference framework where a large language model generates compact reasoning insights to guide a small language model for full reasoning execution.
A cost-aware termination mechanism that adaptively stops the large language model's generation when sufficient reasoning guidance has been accumulated.
A sufficiency classifier trained on one domain that transfers to other domains without retraining for determining reasoning guidance completeness.
idea_ch: 一种大小语言模型协同推理框架：大语言模型生成紧凑推理线索，小语言模型基于线索执行完整推理过程。
一种成本感知的自适应终止机制：动态判断推理指导是否充足，实现大语言模型生成的提前停止。
一种充分性分类器及其跨领域迁移方法：在一个领域训练的充分性分类器可直接迁移至其他领域，无需重新训练。

title: Causal Discovery as Dialectical Aggregation: A Quantitative Argumentation Framework
comment: Accepted at the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2026). This arXiv version includes supplementary material and additional implementation details
summary: Constraint-based causal discovery is brittle in finite-sample regimes because erroneous conditional-independence (CI) decisions can cascade into substantial structural errors. We propose Quantitative Argumentation for Causal Discovery (QACD), a semantics-driven framework that represents CI outcomes as graded, defeasible arguments rather than irreversible constraints. QACD maps statistical test outcomes to argument strengths and aggregates conflicting evidence through connectivity-mediated witness propagation, producing a fixed-point acceptability labeling over candidate adjacencies. Experiments on standard benchmark Bayesian networks suggest that QACD improves structural coherence and interventional reliability in several noisy or inconsistent CI regimes, while remaining competitive with classical constraint-based, hybrid, and prior argumentation-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出QACD框架，将条件独立性检验结果表示为分级可废止论证而非不可逆约束，通过论证语义聚合冲突证据进行因果发现，在噪声场景下表现更好。
AI.motivation: 基于约束的因果发现在有限样本下很脆弱，因为条件独立性判定错误会级联传播导致严重的结构误差。
AI.method: 提出QACD框架，将CI统计检验结果映射为连续论证强度，通过连通性介导的证据传播机制聚合冲突证据，生成候选邻接关系的定点可接受性标注，从而进行因果发现。
AI.result: 在标准基准贝叶斯网络上，QACD在噪声或不一致CI场景下提升了结构一致性和干预可靠性，与经典方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: QACD在噪声或不一致的CI场景下能够提升结构一致性与干预可靠性，且与经典方法竞争力相当。
idea_en: A method for representing conditional independence test results as graded, defeasible arguments instead of binary decisions
A connectivity-mediated witness propagation mechanism that aggregates conflicting evidence to produce fixed-point acceptability labeling over candidate adjacencies
A framework for mapping statistical test outcomes to argument strengths and performing causal discovery through argumentation semantics
A technique for mitigating cascading errors from conditional independence tests in finite-sample regimes using quantitative argumentation
idea_ch: 基于可分级、可废止论证的条件独立性测试结果表示方法，将传统二元决策转换为连续强度的论证
基于连通性介导的证据传播机制，通过聚合冲突证据实现对候选邻接关系的定点可接受性标注
将统计检验结果映射为论证强度，并结合论证语义进行因果发现的框架
一种在有限样本条件下通过论证推理减少条件独立性错误级联传播的方法

title: Structural Enforcement of Goal Integrity in AI Agents via Separation-of-Powers Architecture
summary: Recent evidence suggests that frontier AI systems can exhibit agentic misalignment, generating and executing harmful actions derived from internally constructed goals, even without explicit user requests. Existing mitigation methods, such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and constitutional prompting, operate primarily at the model level and provide only probabilistic safety guarantees. We propose the Policy-Execution-Authorization (PEA) architecture, a "separation-of-powers" design that enforces safety at the system level. PEA decouples intent generation, authorization, and execution into independent, isolated layers connected via cryptographically constrained capability tokens. We present five core contributions: (C1) an Intent Verification Layer (IVL) for ensuring capability-intent consistency; (C2) Intent Lineage Tracking (ILT), which binds all executable intents to the originating user request via cryptographic anchors; (C3) Goal Drift Detection, which rejects semantically divergent intents below a configurable threshold; (C4) an Output Semantic Gate (OSG) that detects implicit coercion using a structured $K \times I \times P$ threat calculus (Knowledge, Influence, Policy); and (C5) a formal verification framework proving that goal integrity is maintained even under adversarial model compromise. By shifting agent alignment from a behavioral property to a structurally enforced system constraint, PEA provides a robust foundation for the governance of autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PEA（策略-执行-授权）的"分权制衡"架构，通过将意图生成、授权和执行解耦为独立隔离层，并借助密码学约束的能力令牌连接，在系统层面强制保障AI智能体的安全性，而非仅依赖模型层面的概率性安全保证。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿AI系统可能表现出代理性错位（agentic misalignment），即在没有用户明确请求的情况下，基于内部构建的目标生成并执行有害行为。现有的RLHF和宪法提示等方法仅在模型层面操作，提供的是概率性安全保证，不足以应对自主智能体的安全挑战。
AI.method: PEA架构采用"分权制衡"设计，将意图生成、授权和执行解耦为独立的隔离层，通过密码学约束的能力令牌进行连接。核心组件包括：意图验证层(IVL)、意图谱系追踪(ILT)、目标漂移检测、输出语义门(OSG)以及形式化验证框架。
AI.result: 通过五个核心贡献（C1-C5）实现了在对抗性模型妥协情况下仍能保持目标完整性的形式化证明，将智能体对齐从行为属性转变为结构强制性的系统约束。
AI.conclusion: PEA架构为自主智能体的治理提供了稳健的基础，将安全从概率性行为保证提升为结构性系统约束。
idea_en: A separation-of-powers architecture for AI systems that decouples intent generation, authorization, and execution into independent, isolated layers connected via cryptographically constrained capability tokens
An Intent Verification Layer (IVL) that ensures consistency between the capabilities of an AI system and its expressed intents before execution
Intent Lineage Tracking (ILT) system that binds all executable intents to originating user requests via cryptographic anchors
Goal Drift Detection mechanism that rejects semantically divergent intents based on a configurable threshold
Output Semantic Gate (OSG) using a structured K×I×P (Knowledge, Influence, Policy) threat calculus to detect implicit coercion in AI outputs
A formal verification framework proving goal integrity is maintained under adversarial model compromise
idea_ch: 一种用于AI系统的分权制衡架构，将意图生成、授权和执行解耦为独立的隔离层，通过密码学约束的能力令牌连接
意图验证层(IVL)，在执行前确保AI系统的能力与其表达的意图之间的一致性
意图谱系追踪(ILT)系统，通过密码学锚点将所有可执行意图绑定到原始用户请求
目标漂移检测机制，基于可配置阈值拒绝语义发散的意图
输出语义门(OSG)，采用结构化的K×I×P（知识、影响、策略）威胁演算检测AI输出中的隐性胁迫

title: Vibe Medicine: Redefining Biomedical Research Through Human-AI Co-Work
summary: With the emergence of large language models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks, the human-AI co-work paradigm known as Vibe Coding is changing how people code, making it more accessible and productive. In scientific research, where workflows are more complex and the burden of specialized labor limits independent researchers and those in low-resource areas, the potential impact is even greater, particularly in biomedicine, which involves heterogeneous data modalities and multi-step analytical pipelines. In this paper, we introduce Vibe Medicine, a co-work paradigm in which clinicians and researchers direct skill-augmented AI agents through natural language to execute complex, multi-step biomedical workflows, while retaining the role of research director who specifies objectives, reviews intermediate results, and makes domain-informed decisions. The enabling infrastructure consists of three layers: capable LLMs, agent frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes Agent, and the OpenClaw medical skills collection, which includes more than 1,000 curated skills from multiple open-source repositories. We analyze the architecture and skill categories of this collection across ten biomedical domains, and present case studies covering rare disease diagnosis, drug repurposing, and clinical trial design that demonstrate end-to-end workflows in practice. We also identify the principal risks, such as hallucination, data privacy, and over-reliance, and outline directions toward more reliable, trustworthy, and clinically integrated agent-assisted research that advances research and technological equity and reduces health care resource disparities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Vibe Medicine范式，让临床医生和研究者通过自然语言指导具备技能的AI代理执行复杂多步骤生物医学工作流，包含三层基础设施：LLM、代理框架（OpenClaw和Hermes Agent）以及包含1000+技能的OpenClaw医学技能集。通过罕见病诊断、药物重定位和临床试验设计等案例展示其应用，并分析了幻觉、数据隐私和过度依赖等风险。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型和AI代理框架改变了人类编码方式（Vibe Coding），但在科学研究领域，尤其是生物医学领域，由于涉及异构数据模态和多步骤分析流程，独立研究者和资源匮乏地区的研究人员面临专业人力负担。现有工作缺乏将自然语言驱动的AI代理应用于复杂生物医学工作流的系统框架。
AI.method: 提出Vibe Medicine协作范式，构建三层基础设施：1）底层为强大的LLM；2）中间层为OpenClaw和Hermes Agent等代理框架；3）顶层为包含1000+来自多个开源仓库的医学技能集。研究者担任"研究主管"角色，通过自然语言指定目标、审查中间结果并做出领域知情决策，AI代理负责执行具体多步骤工作流。
AI.result: 展示了在罕见病诊断、药物重定位和临床试验设计等案例中的端到端工作流应用，分析了十个生物医学领域的技能架构和类别，识别了幻觉、数据隐私和过度依赖等主要风险。
AI.conclusion: Vibe Medicine范式有望推动更可靠、可信且临床整合的代理辅助研究，促进研究和技术公平，减少医疗资源差异。未来方向包括解决幻觉、隐私保护和避免过度依赖等问题。
idea_en: A natural language-driven multi-step biomedical workflow execution system where human acts as research director and AI agents with curated domain skills execute complex pipelines

A three-layer infrastructure architecture for biomedical AI agents consisting of LLMs, agent frameworks (OpenClaw/Hermes Agent), and a curated medical skills collection with 1000+ skills from multiple open-source repositories
A method for rare disease diagnosis using skill-augmented AI agents that navigate heterogeneous biomedical data modalities through natural language directives
A drug repurposing workflow system driven by natural language instructions where AI agents execute multi-step analytical pipelines autonomously
A clinical trial design assistant system where AI agents follow natural language objectives while humans review intermediate results and make domain-informed decisions
A cross-domain biomedical skill categorization framework organizing 1000+ skills across ten biomedical domains for agent-based workflow composition
idea_ch: 一种自然语言驱动的多步骤生物医学工作流执行系统，人类担任研究主管角色，AI代理利用策划的领域技能执行复杂流程
一种三层架构的生物医学AI代理基础设施，包括LLM、代理框架（OpenClaw/Hermes Agent）以及包含1000+个来自多个开源仓库的策划医学技能集
一种利用技能增强型AI代理导航异构生物医学数据模态进行罕见病诊断的方法
一种由自然语言指令驱动的药物重定位工作流系统，AI代理自主执行多步骤分析流程

title: Transferable Human Mobility Network Reconstruction with neuroGravity
summary: Accurate modeling of human mobility is critical for tackling urban planning and public health challenges. In undeveloped regions, the absence of comprehensive travel surveys necessitates reconstructing mobility networks from publicly available data. Here we develop neuroGravity, a physics-informed deep learning model that reliably reconstructs mobility flows from limited observations and transfers to unobserved cities. Using only urban facility and population distributions, we find that neuroGravity's regional representations strongly correlate with socioeconomic and livability status, offering scalable proxies for costly surveys. Furthermore, we uncover that spatial income segregation plays a key role in model transferability: mobility networks are most reliably reconstructed when target cities share similar segregation levels with the source. We design an index to quantify this segregation and accurately predict transferability. Finally, we generate mobility flow proxies for over 1,200 cities worldwide, highlighting neuroGravity's potential to mitigate critical data shortages in resource-limited, underdeveloped areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经引力模型(neuroGravity)，一种融合物理知识的深度学习模型，能从有限的城市设施和人口分布数据中重建并迁移城市间出行流动网络，生成全球1200+城市的出行代理数据。
AI.motivation: 在不发达地区，缺乏全面的出行调查数据，需要从公开数据中重建出行流动网络，以解决城市规划与公共卫生挑战。
AI.method: 提出neuroGravity模型，将物理启发的引力模型与深度学习相结合，利用城市设施和人口分布数据重建出行流动，并通过空间收入隔离指数预测模型的可迁移性。
AI.result: 神经引力模型能从有限观测重建出行流并迁移到未观测城市；区域表征与社会经济/宜居性显著相关；空间收入隔离水平决定迁移可靠性；为全球1200+城市生成了出行流动代理数据。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息深度学习模型(neuroGravity)能有效缓解欠发达地区的出行数据短缺问题，空间收入隔离指数可作为模型迁移性的可靠预测指标。
idea_en: Physics-informed deep learning model (neuroGravity) that integrates gravity law priors with neural networks for reconstructing human mobility flows from limited observations of urban facility and population distributions.
Cross-city mobility network transfer method that reliably reconstructs mobility flows in unobserved target cities based on source city training data.
Spatial income segregation index system designed to quantitatively measure segregation levels between cities and predict model transferability for mobility reconstruction.
Scalable proxy generation system for urban mobility flows using only publicly available facility and population data, validated across 1,200+ cities worldwide.
idea_ch: 神经引力模型(neuroGravity)：将引力定律先验知识与深度学习融合，仅利用城市设施和人口分布等公开数据即可从有限观测中重建人类出行流动网络。

title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
comment: 25 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Submitted to Applied Intelligence (Springer)
summary:
Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems.
  A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims.
  This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对七种信息论度量的实用决策框架，涵盖熵、交叉熵、互信息、转移熵、整合信息(Phi)、有效信息(EI)和自主性，通过三个关键问题指导研究者选择合适度量、估计器和避免误用。
AI.motivation: 信息论度量在AI中广泛应用，但度量选择常与估计器假设、失效模式和安全推断脱节，缺乏系统性的决策指南，导致误用风险。
AI.method: 提出三个规范性问题的决策框架：(i)度量回答什么问题及AI上下文；(ii)适合数据类型和维度的估计器；(iii)最危险的误用。配套提供度量选择流程图和主决策表，以及连接IT量与认知构念的Bridge Boxes。
AI.result: 形成包含流程图和主决策表的实用框架，涵盖AI/ML和决策智能体两大应用领域，通过三个工作示例验证了框架在表征学习、时间影响分析和进化智能体复杂性评估中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为信息论度量的选择和使用提供了系统化指导，有助于减少误用风险，提升AI应用中信息论度量的可靠性和可解释性。
idea_en: A decision framework for information-theoretic measure selection with three prescriptive questions (purpose, estimator, misuse)
A master decision table and flowchart for guiding selection among 7 IT measures in AI contexts
Bridge Boxes methodology linking information-theoretic quantities to cognitive constructs for interpretability
Standardized misuse risk assessment for each IT measure with documented failure modes
Cross-domain application mapping for IT measures spanning representation learning, temporal analysis, and agent complexity
idea_ch: 一种基于三个规范性问题（目的、估计器、误用）的信息论度量选择决策框架
用于指导AI上下文中七种信息论度量的主决策表和流程图
将信息论量连接到认知构念的Bridge Boxes方法，提升可解释性
每种信息论度量的标准化误用风险评估方法，含文档化的失效模式
跨领域应用映射方法，覆盖表征学习、时间分析、智能体复杂性等AI应用

title: Expert Evaluation of LLM's Open-Ended Legal Reasoning on the Japanese Bar Exam Writing Task
comment: 5 pages, Accepted to ICAIL 2026
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on legal benchmarks, including multiple-choice components of bar exams. However, their capacity for generating open-ended legal reasoning in realistic scenarios remains insufficiently explored. Notably, to our best knowledge, there are no prior studies or datasets addressing this issue in the Japanese context.
  This study presents the first dataset designed to evaluate the open-ended legal reasoning performance of LLMs within the Japanese jurisdiction. The dataset is based on the writing component of the Japanese bar examination, which requires examinees to identify multiple legal issues from long narratives and to construct structured legal arguments in free text format. Our key contribution is the manual evaluation of LLMs' generated responses by legal experts, which reveals limitations and challenges in legal reasoning. Moreover, we conducted a manual analysis of hallucinations to characterize when and how the models introduce content not supported by precedent or law.
  Our real exam questions, model-generated responses, and expert evaluations reveal the milestones of current LLMs in the Japanese legal domain. Our dataset and relevant resources will be available online.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向日本司法管辖区、评估大语言模型开放式法律推理能力的数据集，基于日本司法考试写作部分，通过法律专家人工评估揭示了LLM在法律推理中的局限性和幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏针对日本语境下LLM开放式法律推理能力的研究和数据集，现有法律基准（如选择题形式的律师考试）不足以评估模型在真实场景中生成结构化法律论证的能力。
AI.method: 基于日本司法考试写作部分构建评估数据集，要求模型从长篇叙述中识别多个法律问题并以自由文本形式构建结构化法律论证；由法律专家对LLM生成的回答进行人工评估，并对幻觉现象进行人工分析。
AI.result: 揭示了当前LLM在日本法律领域的里程碑表现，发现了模型在法律推理中的局限性以及何时、如何引入法理或法律不支持的幻觉内容。
AI.conclusion: LLM在开放式法律推理任务中仍有显著挑战，尤其是在避免幻觉方面；该数据集和专家评估为后续研究提供了重要资源。
idea_en: A method for constructing legal reasoning evaluation datasets based on bar examination writing components, where long narrative fact patterns are paired with structured argument requirements to assess open-ended legal reasoning in LLMs.
A hallucination analysis framework for legal AI, categorizing when and how LLMs introduce content not supported by precedent or law in open-ended legal reasoning tasks.

title: Modeling Induced Pleasure through Cognitive Appraisal Prediction via Multimodal Fusion
summary: Multimodal affective computing analyzes user-generated social media content to predict emotional states. However, a critical gap remains in understanding how visual content shapes cognitive interpretations and elicits specific affective experiences such as pleasure. This study introduces a novel computational model to infer video-induced pleasure via cognitive appraisal variables. The proposed model addresses four challenges: (1) noisy and inconsistent human labels, (2) the semantic gap between "positive emotions" and "pleasure," (3) the scarcity of pleasure-specific datasets, and (4) the limited interpretability of existing black-box fusion methods. Our approach integrates data-driven and cognitive theory-driven methods, using cognitive appraisal theory and a fuzzy model within an innovative framework. The model employs transformer-based architectures and attention mechanisms for fine-grained multimodal feature extraction and interpretable fusion to capture both inter- and intra-modal dynamics associated with pleasure. This enables the prediction of underlying appraisal variables, thereby bridging the semantic gap and enhancing model explainability beyond conventional statistical associations. Experimental results validate the efficacy of the proposed method in detecting video-induced pleasure, achieving a peak accuracy of 0.6624 in predicting pleasure levels. These findings highlight promising implications for affective content recommendation, intelligent media creation, and advancing our understanding of how digital media influences human emotions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合认知评估理论和模糊模型的多模态情感计算框架，利用Transformer和注意力机制从视频中预测愉悦感，解决了标签噪声、语义鸿沟、数据稀缺和可解释性四个关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对视觉内容如何塑造认知解释并引发特定情感体验（如愉悦感）的理解，且存在标签噪声、情感与愉悦间的语义鸿沟、愉悦数据集稀缺、黑盒融合方法可解释性差等问题。

AI.result: 在预测视频诱导愉悦感方面达到峰值准确率0.6624，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究对情感内容推荐、智能媒体创作以及理解数字媒体对人类情绪影响具有重要启示。

title: FAIR_XAI: Improving Multimodal Foundation Model Fairness via Explainability for Wellbeing Assessment
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: In recent years, the integration of multimodal machine learning in wellbeing assessment has offered transformative potential for monitoring mental health. However, with the rapid advancement of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), their deployment in clinical settings has raised concerns due to their lack of transparency and potential for bias. While previous research has explored the intersection of fairness and Explainable AI (XAI), its application to VLMs for wellbeing assessment and depression prediction remains under-explored. This work investigates VLM performance across laboratory (AFAR-BSFT) and naturalistic (E-DAIC) datasets, focusing on diagnostic reliability and demographic fairness. Performance varied substantially across environments and architectures; Phi3.5-Vision achieved 80.4% accuracy on E-DAIC, while Qwen2-VL struggled at 33.9%. Additionally, both models demonstrated a tendency to over-predict depression on AFAR-BSFT. Although bias existed across both architectures, Qwen2-VL showed higher gender disparities, while Phi-3.5-Vision exhibited more racial bias. Our XAI intervention framework yielded mixed results; fairness prompting achieved perfect equal opportunity for Qwen2-VL at a severe accuracy cost on E-DAIC. On AFAR-BSFT, explainability-based interventions improved procedural consistency but did not guarantee outcome fairness, sometimes amplifying racial bias. These results highlight a persistent gap between procedural transparency and equitable outcomes. We analyse these findings and consolidate concrete recommendations for addressing them, emphasising that future fairness interventions must jointly optimise predictive accuracy, demographic parity, and cross-domain generalisation.

AI.conclusion: 程序透明度与公平结果之间存在持续差距，未来公平性干预必须同时优化预测准确性、人口统计平等性和跨领域泛化能力。

title: Domain-Filtered Knowledge Graphs from Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) extract millions of interpretable features from a language model, but flat feature inventories aren't very useful on their own. Domain concepts get mixed with generic and weakly grounded features, while related ideas are scattered across many units, and there's no way to understand relationships between features. We address this by first constructing a strict domain-specific concept universe from a large SAE inventory using contrastive activations and a multi-stage filtering process. Next, we build two aligned graph views on the filtered set: a co-occurrence graph for corpus-level conceptual structure, organized at multiple levels of granularity, and a transcoder-based mechanism graph that links source-layer and target-layer features through sparse latent pathways. Automated edge labeling then turns these graph views into readable knowledge graphs rather than unlabeled layouts. In a case study on a biology textbook, these graphs recover coherent chapter and subchapter-level structure, reveal concepts that bridge neighboring topics, and transform messy sentence-level activity containing thousands of features into compact, readable views that illustrate the model's local activity. Taken together, this reframes a flat SAE inventory as an internal knowledge graph that converts feature-level interpretability into a global map of model knowledge and enables audits of reasoning faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建基于稀疏自编码器的内部知识图谱，将语言模型中数百万个可解释特征组织为结构化、可读的概念图，从而实现了从特征级可解释性到全局模型知识地图的转化。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器提取的特征是扁平的、无结构的，领域概念与通用特征混杂，相关概念分散在不同单元中，且无法理解特征之间的关系，限制了可解释性的实用价值。

AI.result: 在生物学教科书案例研究中，该方法恢复了连贯的章节和子章节级结构，揭示了连接相邻主题的概念，并将包含数千个特征的混乱句子级活动转化为紧凑、可读的视图。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将扁平的SAE特征库重构为内部知识图谱，将特征级可解释性转化为全局模型知识地图，并能够审计推理的忠实度。

title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
summary: Skill-distillation pipelines learn reusable rules from LLM agent trajectories, but they lack a key signal: how much each step costs. Without per-step cost, a pipeline cannot distinguish adding a missing step to fix a bug from removing an expensive step that never affected the outcome. We introduce ClawTrace, an agent tracing platform that records every LLM call, tool use, and sub-agent spawn during an agent session and compiles each session into a TraceCard: a compact YAML summary with per-step USD cost, token counts, and redundancy flags. Built on ClawTrace, CostCraft is a distillation pipeline that reads TraceCards and produces three types of skill patches. Preserve patches keep behaviors that led to success. Prune patches remove expensive steps that did not matter, each backed by a counterfactual argument against a named high-cost step. Repair patches fix failures grounded in oracle evidence. Ablations on 30 held-out SpreadsheetBench tasks show that both cost attribution and prune patches independently reduce quality regressions. When the same skill is applied to 30 unrelated SkillsBench tasks, an unexpected asymmetry emerges: prune rules transferred across benchmarks and cut median cost by 32%, while preserve rules, trained on benchmark-specific conventions, caused regressions on new task types. We release ClawTrace and TraceCards as open infrastructure for cost-aware agent research.

AI.tldr: ClawTrace是一个记录LLM代理会话中每一步成本的追踪平台，能将会话编译成包含每步美元成本、token数量和冗余标记的TraceCard。基于此，CostCraft蒸馏管道可生成三种技能补丁：保留补丁（保留成功行为）、修剪补丁（移除高成本、无影响的步骤，含反事实论证）、修复补丁（修复失败）。实验表明成本归因和修剪补丁可独立减少质量回归，修剪规则跨基准迁移并降低32%成本。
AI.motivation: 现有技能蒸馏管道从LLM代理轨迹中学习可复用规则时，缺乏每步成本信号，无法区分"添加缺失步骤修复bug"和"移除从未影响结果的高成本步骤"。
AI.method: 构建ClawTrace追踪平台记录每次LLM调用、工具使用和子代理生成，编译为含每步成本的TraceCard。基于该数据，CostCraft管道生成三种技能补丁：保留补丁、修剪补丁（含反事实论证）、修复补丁（基于oracle证据）。
AI.result: 在30个SpreadsheetBench任务上，成本归因和修剪补丁独立减少质量回归。修剪规则跨基准迁移至SkillsBench任务，降低中位成本32%，而保留规则因依赖基准特定惯例导致新任务类型出现回归。
AI.conclusion: ClawTrace和TraceCard为成本感知的代理研究提供了开放基础设施，揭示成本归因在技能蒸馏中的关键作用以及修剪规则的良好跨任务泛化性。

title: Does Machine Unlearning Preserve Clinical Safety? A Risk Analysis for Medical Image Classification
comment: Accepted at SBCAS'26
summary: The application of Deep Learning in medical diagnosis must balance patient safety with compliance with data protection regulations. Machine Unlearning enables the selective removal of training data from deployed models. However, most methods are validated primarily through efficiency and privacy-oriented metrics, with limited attention to clinically asymmetric error costs. In this work, we investigate how unlearning affects clinical risk in binary medical image classification. We show that standard unlearning strategies (Fine-Tuning, Random Labeling, and SalUn) may reduce test utility while increasing false-negative rates, thereby amplifying clinical risk. To mitigate this, we propose SalUn-CRA (Clinical Risk-Aware), a variant of SalUn that replaces random relabeling with entropy-based forgetting for malignant samples in the forget set, preventing the model from learning harmful benign associations. We evaluate on DermaMNIST and PathMNIST medical image datasets under 20% and 50% data removal. Using Global Risk metrics with asymmetric costs, SalUn-CRA achieves lower or comparable clinical risk to full retraining while preserving unlearning effectiveness. These results suggest that clinical risk should be an integral component of unlearning validation in medical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SalUn-CRA方法，在医学图像分类的机器遗忘中引入临床风险感知机制，通过熵基遗忘替代随机重标签，在降低假阴性率的同时保持遗忘效果，使临床风险接近完整重训练水平。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法主要关注效率和隐私指标，忽略了医学诊断中不对称的临床错误代价（如假阴性的危害远大于假阳性），导致遗忘后临床风险增加。
AI.method: 提出SalUn-CRA，在SalUn基础上将遗忘集中恶性样本的随机重标签替换为熵基遗忘，防止模型学习有害的良性关联，保留对遗忘集样本的不确定性而非强行重标。
AI.result: 在DermaMNIST和PathMNIST数据集上，20%和50%数据移除场景下，SalUn-CRA的全局临床风险低于或接近完整重训练，同时保持有效的遗忘能力。
AI.conclusion: 临床风险应作为医学系统中机器遗忘验证的关键组成部分，现有遗忘方法需要针对临床不对称代价进行专门设计。

title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An EU-AI-Act-Compliant Open-Source Package / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein KI-VO-konformes Open-Source-Paket
comment: Bilingual twin paper: English version first, German original below (91 pages total). Single shared bibliography
summary: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI workflows, Common-Platform-Enumeration (CPE) identifier, REUSE-conformant licensing, release pipeline). Interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning (AutoML), as well as deep-learning and large-language-model backends are deliberately excluded, because each of these components either enlarges the attack surface, introduces non-determinism, or impairs reproducibility. A bidirectional traceability matrix maps every regulatory provision onto the corresponding mechanism in the code; an end-to-end example of European-market electricity generation, transmission, and consumption forecasting demonstrates the application. The package is open-source and available under Affero General Public License (AGPL) 3.0-or-later.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 spotforecast2-safe 的合规性设计方法，将欧盟AI法案、IEC 61508、ISA/IEC 62443及网络弹性法案的要求直接嵌入Python时间序列预测库的API契约、持久化格式和CI流程中，通过四条不可协商的代码开发规则和相应的流程规则实现安全关键环境下的合规，并排除了交互式可视化、AutoML、深度学习等可能扩大攻击面或引入非确定性的组件。
AI.motivation: 现有开源工具在安全关键环境中的合规解决方案（如扫描器、模板、运行时层）始终独立于被使用的库之外工作，缺乏将合规要求直接嵌入库内部的集成方法。

title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems
comment: Pre-print of NeurIPS 2026 main-track submission. Earliest preprint version on Zenodo 31 March 2026 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19353664); cross-posted to TDCommons (dpubs_series/9683, 1 April 2026). Six Zenodo revisions and three TDCommons revisions through 9 April 2026 (Zenodo concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19353663). 41 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures
summary:
Despite a century of empirical memory research, existing AI agent memory systems rely on system-engineering metaphors (virtual-memory paging, flat LLM storage, Zettelkasten notes), none integrating principles of consolidation, forgetting, and reconsolidation.
  We present ZenBrain, a multi-layer memory architecture integrating fifteen neuroscience models. It implements seven memory layers (working, short-term, episodic, semantic, procedural, core, cross-context) orchestrated by nine foundational algorithms (Two-Factor Synaptic Model, vmPFC-coupled FSRS, Simulation-Selection sleep, Bayesian confidence, and five more) plus six new Predictive Memory Architecture (PMA) components: a four-channel NeuromodulatorEngine, prediction-error-gated ReconsolidationEngine, TripleCopyMemory with divergent decay, four-dimensional PriorityMap with amygdala fast-path, StabilityProtector (NogoA/HDAC3 analogue), and MetacognitiveMonitor for bias detection.
  The 15-algorithm ablation reveals a cooperative survival network: under stress, 9 of 15 algorithms become individually critical (delta-Q up to -93.7%, Wilcoxon, 10 seeds, alpha=0.005). Simulation-Selection sleep achieves 37% stability improvement (p<0.005) with 47.4% storage reduction. TripleCopyMemory retains S(t)=0.912 at 30 days; PriorityMap reaches NDCG@10=0.997.
  Multi-layer routing beats a flat single-layer baseline by 20.7% F1 on LoCoMo (p<0.005) and 19.5% on MemoryArena (p=0.015). On LongMemEval-500, ZenBrain holds the highest mean rank on all 12 system-judge cells (4 systems x 3 LLM judges), three-judge mean J=0.545 vs letta=0.485, a-mem=0.414, mem0=0.394; all 9 pair-wise contrasts clear Bonferroni (alpha=0.05/18, min p=6.2e-31, d in [0.18, 0.52]). Under LongMemEval's binary judge, ZenBrain reaches 91.3% of oracle accuracy at 1/106th the per-query token budget. Open-source with 11,589 automated test cases.

title: MarketBench: Evaluating AI Agents as Market Participants
summary: Markets are a promising way to coordinate AI agent activity for similar reasons to those used to justify markets more broadly. In order to effectively participate in markets, agents need to have informative signals of their own ability to successfully complete a task and the cost of doing so. We propose MarketBench, a benchmark for assessing whether AI agents have these capabilities. We use a 93-task subset of SWE-bench Lite, a software engineering benchmark, with six recently released LLMs as a demonstration. These LLMs are miscalibrated on both success probability and token usage, and auctions built from these self-reports diverge from a full-information allocation. A follow-up intervention where we add information about capabilities from prior experiments to the context improves calibration, but only modestly narrows the gap to a full-information benchmark. We also document the performance of a market-based scaffolding with these LLMs. Our results point to self-assessment as a key bottleneck for market-style coordination of AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MarketBench基准，用于评估AI智能体在市场中自我评估能力（成功概率和成本）。通过SWE-bench Lite子集和6个LLM实验，发现LLM在自我校准上存在偏差，导致市场分配偏离最优。添加历史信息可改善校准，但差距仍存。
AI.motivation: 市场机制有望协调AI智能体活动，但智能体需要能准确评估自身完成任务的成功概率和成本。当前缺乏评估这种自我评估能力的基准，而自我评估是市场协调的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建MarketBench基准，使用SWE-bench Lite中93个软件工程任务，测试6个最新LLM。LLM需自我报告成功概率和token使用量，与实际表现对比评估校准度。构建基于自我报告的市场拍卖分配，与全信息最优分配对比。最后进行信息干预实验，将历史能力信息加入上下文。
AI.result: LLM在成功概率和token用量上均存在校准偏差（miscalibrated）。基于自我报告的市场拍卖分配偏离全信息最优分配。加入历史能力信息后校准有所改善，但缩小差距有限。
AI.conclusion: 自我评估能力是市场式协调AI智能体的关键瓶颈。现有的LLM在自我评估上存在系统性偏差，需要进一步改进。

title: LLM-Augmented Traffic Signal Control with LSTM-Based Traffic State Prediction and Safety-Constrained Decision Support
summary: Traffic signal control is a critical task in intelligent transportation systems, yet conventional fixed-time and rule-based methods often struggle to adapt to dynamic traffic demand and provide limited decision interpretability. This study proposes an LLM-augmented traffic signal control framework that integrates LSTM-based short-term traffic state prediction, predictive phase selection, structured large language model reasoning, and safety-constrained action filtering. The LSTM module forecasts future queue length, waiting time, vehicle count, and lane occupancy based on recent intersection-level observations. A predictive controller then generates candidate signal actions, while the LLM module evaluates these actions using structured traffic-state inputs and produces congestion diagnoses, phase adjustment recommendations, and natural-language explanations. To ensure operational reliability, all LLM-generated recommendations are validated by a safety filter before execution. Simulation-based experiments in SUMO compare the proposed method with fixed-time control, rule-based control, and an LSTM-based predictive baseline under balanced demand, directional peak demand, and sudden surge scenarios. The results indicate that the proposed framework improves traffic efficiency, especially under dynamic and non-recurrent traffic conditions, while maintaining zero constraint violations after safety filtering. Overall, this study demonstrates that LLMs can enhance traffic signal control when used as constrained reasoning and decision-support modules rather than direct low-level controllers. Keywords: Intelligent Transportation Systems; Traffic Signal Control; Large Language Models; LSTM; Traffic State Prediction; Decision Support; Safety-Constrained Control; SUMO Simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种LLM增强的交通信号控制框架，结合LSTM预测、相位选择、LLM推理和安全约束过滤，在SUMO仿真中验证了其在动态交通场景下的有效性。

AI.result: 在SUMO仿真中，与固定时间控制、规则控制和LSTM基线相比，该方法在平衡需求、方向性高峰和突发激增场景下均提升了交通效率，且经安全过滤后零约束违规。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为受约束的推理和决策支持模块增强交通信号控制，而非直接作为底层控制器。

title: Agentic AI platforms for autonomous training and rule induction of human-human and virus-human protein-protein interactions
comment: Other correspondence email: donguyenhung238@gmail.com
summary: We instruct an AI agent to construct two separate agentic AI platforms: one for autonomous training of predictive ML models for human-human and virus-human PPI, and the other for inducing explicit general rules governing human-human and virus-human PPI. The first agentic AI platform for autonomous training of predictive ML models for PPI is designed to consist of five AI agents that handle autonomous data collection, data verification, feature embedding, model design, and training and validation on three-way protein-disjoint cross-fold datasets. For human-human and human-virus PPIs, the final three-way protein-disjoint ensemble achieves an accuracy of 87.3% and 86.5%, respectively. For cross-checking and interpretability purposes, the second agentic AI platform is designed to replace ML predictions with human-readable rules derived from protein embeddings, physicochemical autocovariance descriptors, compartment annotations, pathway-domain overlap, and graph contexts. For human-human PPI, it is defined by a two-rule induction, whereas human-virus is induced by a more complex set of weighted rules. The rules induced by the second agentic platform align with the SHAP-identified features from the predictive ML models built by the first agentic platform. Taken together, our work demonstrates the agentic AI's ability to orchestrate from data planning to execution, and from rule induction to explanation in ML, opening the door to various applications.

AI.motivation: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）的预测在生物学和医学中至关重要，但传统方法缺乏自动化、可解释性和从数据到规则的端到端智能。本文旨在利用智能体AI实现PPI预测建模和规则诱导的自主化与可解释化。

title: GAMED.AI: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Educational Game Generation
summary: We introduce GameDAI, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that transforms instructor-provided questions into fully playable, pedagogically grounded educational games validated through formal mechanic contracts. Built on phase-based LangGraph sub-graphs, deterministic Quality Gates, and structured Pydantic schemas, GameDAI supports two template families encompassing 15 interaction mechanics across spatial reasoning, procedural execution, and higher-order Bloom's Taxonomy objectives. Evaluated on 200 questions spanning five subject domains, the system achieves a 90% validation pass rate, 98.3% schema compliance, and 73% token reduction over ReAct agents (${\sim}$73,500 $\rightarrow$ ${\sim}$19,900 tokens/game) at $0.46 per game. Within this model configuration, these results suggest that phase-bounded architectural structure correlates more strongly with alignment quality than prompting strategy alone. Our demonstration lets attendees generate Bloom's-aligned games from natural language in under 60 seconds, inspect Quality Gate outputs at each pipeline phase, and browse a curated library of 50 games spanning all 15 mechanic types.

title: Context-Aware Hospitalization Forecasting Evaluations for Decision Support using LLMs
summary: Medical and public health experts must make real-time resource decisions, such as expanding hospital bed capacity, based on projected hospitalization trends during large-scale healthcare disruptions (e.g., operational failures or pandemics). Forecasting models can assist in this task by analyzing large volumes of resource-related data at the facility level, but they must be reliable for decision-making under real-world data conditions. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can incorporate richer forms of context into numerical forecasting. Whereas traditional models rely primarily on temporal context (i.e., past observations), LLMs can also leverage non-temporal public health context such as demographic, geographic, and population-level features. However, it remains unclear how these models should be used to produce stable or decision-relevant predictions in real-world healthcare settings. To evaluate how LLMs can be effectively used in this setting, we evaluate three approaches across 60 counties with low-,mid-, and high-hospitalization intensities in the United States: direct LLM-based forecasting, classical time-series models, and a context-augmented hybrid pipeline (HybridARX) that incorporates LLM-derived signals into structured models. Because the goal is operational decision-making rather than error minimization alone, we evaluate performance with bias and lead-lag alignment in addition to standard forecasting metrics. Our results show that HybridARX improves over classical ARX by yielding more stable and better-calibrated forecasts, particularly when incorporating noisy contextual signals into structured time-series models. These findings suggest that, in non-stationary healthcare resource forecasting, LLMs are most useful when embedded within structured hybrid models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在大规模医疗中断事件（如疫情）中，如何利用大语言模型（LLM）辅助医院床位容量等实时资源决策。作者评估了三种方法：纯LLM预测、经典时间序列模型、以及结合LLM上下文信号的混合模型（HybridARX）。结果表明，混合模型在非平稳医疗资源预测中更稳定、更准确。
AI.motivation: 医疗和公共卫生专家在疫情或运营故障等大规模医疗中断期间，需要基于预测的住院趋势做出实时资源决策（如扩大床位容量）。现有预测模型主要依赖时间上下文，而LLM能引入人口统计、地理等非时间公共健康语境，但如何在真实医疗场景中稳定、可靠地使用这些模型尚不明确。
AI.method: 在美国60个低、中、高住院强度的县，评估三种预测方法：1）纯LLM直接预测；2）经典时间序列模型；3）混合HybridARX管道——将LLM提取的上下文信号融入结构化时间序列模型。使用偏差、超前滞后对齐以及标准预测指标进行评估。
AI.result: HybridARX优于经典ARX模型，在融入带噪声的上下文信号时，能产生更稳定、校准更好的预测结果。纯LLM预测效果不如混合方法。
AI.conclusion: 在非平稳的医疗资源预测场景中，LLM最有效的使用方式是将它们嵌入到结构化的混合模型中，而非直接用于预测。
idea_en: A context-augmented hybrid forecasting pipeline (HybridARX) that integrates LLM-derived non-temporal contextual signals (e.g., demographic, geographic, population-level features) into classical structured time-series models (ARX) for healthcare resource forecasting.

A method for evaluating forecasting models in operational healthcare decision-making using bias and lead-lag alignment metrics beyond standard error minimization, enabling more decision-relevant performance assessment.

title: An empirical evaluation of the risks of AI model updates using clinical data: stability, arbitrariness, and fairness
comment: Accepted to iEEE EMBC 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures
summary: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) models used in clinical settings are increasingly deployed to support clinical decision-making. However, when training data become stale due to changes in demographics, environment, or patient behaviors, model performance can degrade substantially. While updating models with new training data is necessary, such updates may also introduce new risks. We evaluated the proposed monitoring framework on four publicly available U.S.-based Type 1 Diabetes datasets containing high-resolution continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data, comprising approximately 11,300 weekly observations from 496 participants under 20 years of age. All datasets included structured sociodemographic information. Using the prediction of severe hyperglycemia events in children with type 1 diabetes as a case study, we examine how different model update strategies can adversely affect model stability (e.g., by causing predictions to "flip" for a large number of cases after an update), increase arbitrariness in predictions, or worsen accuracy equity and the balance of error rates across subpopulations. We propose multiple dimensions for continuous monitoring to detect these issues and argue that such monitoring is essential for the development of trustworthy clinical decision support systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI/ML临床决策支持模型因数据过时导致性能下降的问题，提出了一个多维度持续监控框架，用于检测模型更新后出现的预测翻转、任意性增加、准确性公平性恶化等问题，并在儿童1型糖尿病高血糖事件预测数据集上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 临床AI/ML模型在部署后，训练数据会因人口统计特征、环境或患者行为变化而过时，导致性能显著下降。虽然需要用新数据更新模型，但更新可能引入新风险，如预测不稳定、公平性恶化等，现有研究缺乏对这类风险的系统性监控方法。
AI.method: 提出一个多维度持续监控框架，通过多个指标（预测翻转率、预测任意性、准确率公平性、子群体错误率平衡等）检测模型更新后的不良影响。以儿童1型糖尿病严重高血糖事件预测为案例，在4个公开CGM数据集（约11,300周观测值，496名20岁以下参与者）上评估不同模型更新策略。
AI.result: 不同模型更新策略会导致大规模预测翻转、增加预测任意性、恶化准确率公平性和子群体错误率平衡。所提出的监控框架能有效检测这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 持续监控对于构建可信赖的临床决策支持系统至关重要，多维度监控框架能够识别模型更新带来的各类风险，确保模型在实际部署中的稳定性和公平性。

title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People
summary: Indoor navigation remains a critical accessibility challenge for the blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, as existing solutions rely on costly per-building infrastructure. We present an agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base to generate safe, accessible navigation instructions with lightweight infrastructure. The system has two phases: a multi-agent module that parses the floor plan into a spatial knowledge graph through a self-correcting pipeline with iterative retry loops and corrective feedback; and a Path Planner that generates accessible navigation instructions, with a Safety Evaluator agent assessing potential hazards along each route. We evaluate the system on the real-world UMBC Math and Psychology building (floors MP-1 and MP-3) and on the CVC-FP benchmark. On MP-1, we achieve success rates of 92.31%, 76.92%, and 61.54% for short, medium, and long routes, outperforming the strongest single-call baseline (Claude 3.7 Sonnet) at 84.62%, 69.23%, and 53.85%. On MP-3, we reach 76.92%, 61.54%, and 38.46%, compared to the best baseline at 61.54%, 46.15%, and 23.08%. These results show consistent gains over single-call LLM baselines and demonstrate that our workflow is a scalable solution for accessible indoor navigation for BLV individuals.

AI.tldr: 提出一个智能体框架，将单张楼层平面图转换为结构化的空间知识图谱，为盲人和低视力（BLV）个体生成安全、可访问的室内导航指令，无需昂贵的建筑基础设施。
AI.motivation: 现有室内导航方案依赖每栋建筑的高成本基础设施，对于盲人和低视力人群而言，可访问性挑战仍然严峻，亟需一种轻量级、可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段是多智能体模块，通过自纠正流水线（含迭代重试循环和纠正反馈）将平面图解析为空间知识图谱；第二阶段是路径规划器生成可访问导航指令，并配备安全评估智能体评估沿途潜在危险。

AI.conclusion: 该工作流是面向BLV个体的可扩展室内导航解决方案，展示了比单次调用LLM基线更一致的优势。

title: Representational Curvature Modulates Behavioral Uncertainty in Large Language Models
summary: In autoregressive large language models (LLMs), temporal straightening offers an account of how the next-token prediction objective shapes representations. Models learn to progressively straighten the representational trajectory of input sequences across layers, potentially facilitating next-token prediction via linear extrapolation. However, a direct link between this trajectory and token-level behavior has been missing. We provide such a link by relating contextual curvature-a geometric measure of how sharply the representational trajectory bends over recent context-to next-token entropy. Across two models (GPT-2 XL and Pythia-2.8B), contextual curvature is correlated with entropy, and this relationship emerges during training. Perturbation experiments reveal selective dependence: manipulating curvature through trajectory-aligned interventions reliably modulates entropy, while geometrically misaligned perturbations have no effect. Finally, regularizing representations to be straighter during training modestly reduces token-level entropy without degrading validation loss. These results identify trajectory curvature as a task-aligned representational feature that influences behavioral uncertainty in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型的表征轨迹曲率（contextual curvature）与下一个词的熵之间存在相关性，并通过干预实验证明这种几何特征能影响模型行为的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽提出自回归LLM通过逐层拉直表征轨迹来促进线性外推预测，但未直接建立轨迹几何与token级行为（如预测不确定性）之间的联系。
AI.method: 1) 在GPT-2 XL和Pythia-2.8B上计算contextual curvature并与next-token entropy关联；2) 进行轨迹对齐/错位的扰动干预实验；3) 训练中施加表征拉直正则化。
AI.result: 上下文曲率与熵显著相关且随训练涌现；轨迹对齐的扰动可调控熵，几何错位的扰动无效；拉直正则化可适度降低熵而不损害验证损失。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹曲率是LLM中与任务对齐的表征特征，可用于调控模型的行为不确定性。
idea_en: A method for controlling prediction uncertainty in large language models by geometrically modulating the contextual curvature of representational trajectories through layer-wise intervention.
A training regularization technique that imposes straightness constraints on representational trajectories to reduce token-level entropy while maintaining validation loss.
A perturbation-based mechanism for selective entropy modulation in LLMs using trajectory-aligned interventions that affect curvature without disrupting geometrically misaligned directions.

title: Failure-Centered Runtime Evaluation for Deployed Trilingual Public-Space Agents
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. arXiv preprint
summary:
This paper presents PSA-Eval, a failure-centered runtime evaluation framework for deployed trilingual public-space agents. The central claim is that, when the evaluation object shifts from a static input-output mapping to a runtime system, the basic unit of analysis should shift from score to failure. PSA-Eval extends the conventional chain Question -> Answer -> Score -> End into Question -> Batch -> Run -> Score -> Failure Case -> Repair -> Regression Batch, making failures traceable, reviewable, repairable, and regression-testable.
  The framework uses trilingual equivalent inputs as controlled probes for observing group-level cross-language policy drift. We conduct a pilot study on a real trilingual digital front-desk system deployed in the lobby of an international financial institution. The pilot uses a simplified single-foundation-model setting (MA = MB), so the observed drift should not be interpreted as an A/B foundation-model difference. The study contains 81 samples organized into 27 trilingual equivalent question groups. Although the system achieves an average score of 23.15/24, 14 groups show non-zero cross-language score drift, 5 groups show drift of at least 3 points, and the maximum drift reaches 9 points. These results provide initial evidence that failure-centered runtime evaluation can expose structured deployment signals hidden by aggregate scoring.

AI.tldr: PSA-Eval提出以故障为中心的运行时评估框架，将传统的问答评分流程扩展为包含故障追踪、修复和回归测试的闭环流程，通过三语等效输入探测跨语言策略漂移。在真实金融场景三语数字前台系统中，尽管平均得分高达23.15/24，仍发现显著跨语言得分漂移（最大达9分），证明该框架能暴露聚合评分掩盖的结构性部署问题。
AI.motivation: 传统评估方法以静态输入-输出映射和聚合评分（如平均分）为中心，无法有效捕获部署后运行时系统中的故障模式、跨语言策略漂移等结构化问题，亟需一种以故障为中心、支持追踪-审查-修复-回归测试的运行时评估框架。
AI.method: PSA-Eval将传统链条 Question->Answer->Score->End 扩展为 Question->Batch->Run->Score->Failure Case->Repair->Regression Batch，以故障为基本分析单元，利用三语等效输入作为受控探针，在组级别观测跨语言策略漂移，并通过回归批次验证修复效果。
AI.result: 在真实三语数字前台系统（81个样本、27组三语等效问题）的初步研究中，系统平均得分23.15/24，但14组存在非零跨语言得分漂移，5组漂移至少3分，最大漂移达9分。
AI.conclusion: 以故障为中心的运行时评估能够暴露聚合评分所掩盖的结构化部署信号（如跨语言策略漂移），为部署后系统的持续质量保障提供了新的方法论。
idea_en: A runtime evaluation framework for deployed public-space agents that uses failure as the basic unit of analysis instead of score, with a pipeline of Question -> Batch -> Run -> Score -> Failure Case -> Repair -> Regression Batch.
A method of using trilingual equivalent input sets as controlled probes to detect cross-language policy drift in deployed multi-language AI systems.
A regression-testing mechanism for runtime systems that automatically re-runs failure cases after repair to verify fix effectiveness at the deployment site.
A failure-centric evaluation system that replaces the conventional static input-output scoring with traceable, reviewable, and repairable failure case lifecycle management.
A technique for exposing structured deployment signals (e.g., systematic cross-language score disparities) that are hidden by aggregate scoring metrics in production AI systems.

title: CT-FineBench: A Diagnostic Fidelity Benchmark for Fine-Grained Evaluation of CT Report Generation
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Main
summary: The evaluation of generated reports remains a critical challenge in Computed Tomography (CT) report generation, due to the large volume of text, the diversity and complexity of findings, and the presence of fine-grained, disease-oriented attributes. Conventional evaluation metrics offer only coarse measures of lexical overlap or entity matching and fail to reflect the granular diagnostic accuracy required for clinical use. To address this gap, we propose CT-FineBench, a benchmark built from CT-RATE and Merlin to evaluate the fine-grained factual consistency of CT reports, constructed from CT-RATE and Merlin. Our benchmark is constructed through a meticulous, Question-Answering (QA) based process: first, we identify and structure key, finding-specific clinical attributes (like location, size, margin). Second, we systematically transform these attributes into a QA dataset, where questions probe for specific clinical details grounded in gold-standard reports. The evaluation protocol for CT-FineBench involves using this QA dataset to query a machine-generated report and scoring the correctness of the answers. This allows for a comprehensive, interpretable, and clinically-relevant assessment, moving beyond superficial lexical overlap to pinpoint specific clinical errors. Experiments show that CT-FineBench correlates better with expert clinical assessment and is substantially more sensitive to fine-grained factual errors than prior metrics.

AI.tldr: CT-FineBench是一个基于QA的CT报告细粒度事实一致性评估基准，通过将关键临床属性转化为问答数据集来评估生成报告，比传统指标更敏感、更贴合临床评估。
AI.motivation: 现有CT报告生成评估指标仅提供粗略的词法重叠或实体匹配度量，无法反映细粒度诊断准确性，缺乏临床适用性。

title: QED: An Open-Source Multi-Agent System for Generating Mathematical Proofs on Open Problems
summary: We explore a central question in AI for mathematics: can AI systems produce original, nontrivial proofs for open research problems? Despite strong benchmark performance, producing genuinely novel proofs remains an outstanding challenge for LLMs. Through systematic experiments with frontier LLMs on research-level proof tasks, we identify seven failure modes that prevent reliable proof generation, including context contamination, citation hallucination, hand-waving on key steps and misallocation of proof effort, unstable proof plans, unfocused verification, problem modification and single-model bottleneck. We argue that the gap between benchmark success and research-level proving is primarily one of system design, due to those failure modes. We present QED, an open-source multi-agent proof system in which each architectural decision directly addresses a specific failure mode. Evaluated on five open problems in applied analysis and PDEs contributed by domain experts, QED produces correct proofs for three problems, each verified by the contributing experts as original and nontrivial. QED is released as open-source software at https://github.com/proofQED/QED.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QED，一个开源多智能体证明系统，通过针对性设计解决LLM在研究级数学证明中的七大失败模式，在三个开放问题上生成了专家验证的正确原创证明。
AI.motivation: 探索AI能否在开放研究问题上产生原创、非平凡的数学证明，弥补LLM在基准测试成功与研究级证明之间的差距。
AI.method: 系统分析LLM在研究级证明任务中的七大失败模式，设计QED多智能体证明系统，每个架构决策直接针对特定失败模式进行优化。
AI.result: 在五个开放应用分析与PDE问题中，QED成功为三个问题生成正确证明，并经领域专家验证为原创且非平凡。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试成功与研究级证明之间的差距主要是系统设计问题，通过针对性架构设计可显著提升AI生成原创数学证明的能力。
idea_en: A multi-agent proof system architecture where each agent is specifically designed to counteract a known failure mode of LLMs in mathematical theorem proving, enabling reliable generation of original research-level proofs.
A context contamination detection and mitigation mechanism that prevents LLMs from inappropriately borrowing contextual information across different proof attempts or problem statements.
A citation hallucination prevention module that verifies and grounds mathematical references against a trusted knowledge base before inclusion in generated proofs.
A proof effort allocation system that automatically identifies critical lemmas and steps requiring detailed reasoning versus auxiliary steps that can be handled with higher-level abstractions.
A proof plan stabilization mechanism that maintains coherent proof strategy across multiple reasoning steps and prevents mid-proof plan switching or abandonment.
A targeted verification approach that focuses computational resources on the most uncertain or critical parts of a proof rather than uniform verification across all steps.
A problem integrity preservation system that prevents LLMs from subtly modifying the original problem statement during the proving process.

title: AgentPulse: A Continuous Multi-Signal Framework for Evaluating AI Agents in Deployment
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Static benchmarks measure what AI agents can do at a fixed point in time but not how they are adopted, maintained, or experienced in deployment. We introduce AgentPulse, a continuous evaluation framework scoring 50 agents across 10 workload categories along four factors (Benchmark Performance, Adoption Signals, Community Sentiment, and Ecosystem Health) aggregated from 18 real-time signals across GitHub, package registries, IDE marketplaces, social platforms, and benchmark leaderboards. Three analyses ground the framework. The four factors capture largely complementary information (n=50; $ρ_{\max}=0.61$ for Adoption-Ecosystem, all others $|ρ| \leq 0.37$). A circularity-controlled test (n=35) shows the Benchmark+Sentiment sub-composite, which contains no GitHub-derived signals, predicts external adoption proxies it does not aggregate: GitHub stars ($ρ_s=0.52$, $p<0.01$) and Stack Overflow question volume ($ρ_s=0.49$, $p<0.01$), with VS Code installs ($ρ_s=0.44$, $p<0.05$) reported as illustrative given that only 11 of 35 agents have non-zero installs. On the n=11 subset with published SWE-bench scores, composite and benchmark-only rankings are nearly uncorrelated ($ρ_s=0.25$; 9 of 11 agents shift by at least 2 ranks), driven by a strong negative Adoption-Capability correlation among closed-source high-capability agents within this subset. This is precisely why we rest the framework's validity claim on the broader n=35 test rather than the SWE-bench overlap. AgentPulse surfaces deployment signal absent from benchmarks; it is a methodology, not a ground-truth ranking. The framework, all collected signals, scoring outputs, and evaluation harness are released under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: AgentPulse是一个持续评估AI代理的框架，通过18个实时信号从4个维度（基准性能、采用信号、社区情感、生态健康）对50个代理进行评分。研究发现基准排名与实际部署信号之间存在显著差异，强调了持续评估框架的重要性。
AI.motivation: 静态基准只能衡量AI代理在固定时间点的能力，无法反映其在部署中的采纳、维护和实际使用体验。现有评估方法缺乏对代理生命周期实时状态的监测。
AI.method: 构建AgentPulse框架，从GitHub、包注册表、IDE市场、社交平台和基准排行榜等18个实时信号中，聚合出基准性能、采用信号、社区情感和生态健康四个因子，对50个代理进行持续评分。
AI.result: 四个因子捕获互补信息（最大相关性ρ=0.61）；基准+情感子复合指标可预测外部采用指标（GitHub星标ρ=0.52，Stack Overflow问题量ρ=0.49）；在SWE-bench子集上复合排名与基准排名几乎不相关（ρ=0.25），9/11代理排名偏移至少2位。
AI.conclusion: AgentPulse揭示了基准测试无法捕获的实际部署信号，是一个方法论而非绝对排名。该框架证明仅凭基准性能无法反映代理的真实生态表现，持续多维度评估至关重要。
idea_en: A continuous evaluation framework for AI agents that aggregates real-time signals from multiple sources (GitHub, package registries, IDE marketplaces, social platforms, and benchmark leaderboards) to score agents across four complementary factors: Benchmark Performance, Adoption Signals, Community Sentiment, and Ecosystem Health.

A circularity-controlled testing methodology that validates the predictive power of non-GitHub-derived composite signals (Benchmark+Sentiment) for external adoption proxies such as GitHub stars, Stack Overflow question volume, and VS Code installs.

A multi-factor ranking system that reveals discrepancies between benchmark-only rankings and composite deployment-aware rankings, demonstrating that closed-source high-capability agents exhibit negative Adoption-Capability correlation.

一种循环控制测试方法，用于验证非GitHub来源的复合指标（基准+情感）对GitHub星标、Stack Overflow问题量和VS Code安装量等外部采用代理的预测能力。
一种多因素排名系统，揭示纯基准排名与复合部署感知排名之间的差异，并发现闭源高能力代理存在采用-能力负相关现象。

title: A2DEPT: Large Language Model-Driven Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Program Trees
comment: Preprint
summary: Designing heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) is a fundamental yet challenging task that traditionally requires extensive domain expertise. Recently, Large Language Model (LLM)-based Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) has shown promise in autonomously generating heuristic components with minimal human intervention. However, most existing LLM-based AHD methods enforce fixed algorithmic templates to ensure executability, which confines the search to component-level tuning and limits system-level algorithmic expressiveness. To enable open-ended solver synthesis beyond rigid templates, we propose Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Program Trees (A2DEPT), which treats LLMs as system-level algorithm architects. A2DEPT explores the vast program space via a tree-structured evolutionary search with hybrid selection and hierarchical operators, enabling iterative refinement of complete algorithms. To make open-ended generation practical, we enforce executability with a lightweight program-maintenance loop that performs feedback-driven repair. In experiments, A2DEPT consistently outperforms representative LLM-based baselines on both standard and highly constrained benchmarks. On the standard benchmarks, it reduces the mean normalized optimality gap by 9.8% relative to the strongest competing AHD baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出A2DEPT方法，利用大语言模型通过进化程序树自动设计组合优化问题的完整求解算法，突破固定模板限制，实现开放式的算法自动生成。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based自动启发式设计方法受限于固定算法模板，只能在组件层面调优，缺乏系统级的算法表达能力。需要一种更灵活的方法来生成完整的求解算法。
AI.method: 提出A2DEPT框架：将LLM作为系统级算法架构师，通过树结构的进化搜索（混合选择+分层算子）探索程序空间，并采用轻量级程序维护循环进行反馈驱动的修复以确保可执行性。
AI.result: 在标准基准和高度约束基准上，A2DEPT持续优于代表性LLM基线方法。在标准基准上，相比最强竞争AHD基线，平均归一化最优间隙降低9.8%。
AI.conclusion: A2DEPT通过进化程序树将LLM用于系统级算法设计，突破了固定模板的限制，证明了在组合优化问题中自动生成完整算法的可行性和有效性。
idea_en: A method for automated algorithm design using LLMs as system-level architects with evolutionary program trees, enabling open-ended generation of complete optimization solvers.
A tree-structured evolutionary search mechanism with hybrid selection and hierarchical operators for exploring algorithmic program spaces.
A lightweight program-maintenance loop employing feedback-driven repair to ensure executability of LLM-generated algorithms during evolutionary search.
idea_ch: 一种利用大语言模型作为系统级架构师、结合进化程序树的自动算法设计方法，实现完整优化求解器的开放式生成。

一种采用反馈驱动修复的轻量级程序维护循环，确保进化搜索中由LLM生成的算法的可执行性。

title: Grounding Before Generalizing: How AI Differs from Humans in Causal Transfer
summary: Extracting abstract causal structures and applying them to novel situations is a hallmark of human intelligence. While Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on a wide range of reasoning tasks, their capacity for interactive causal learning -- inducing latent structures through sequential exploration and transferring them across contexts -- remains uncharacterized. Human learners accomplish such transfer after minimal exposure, whereas classical Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents fail catastrophically. Whether state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence (AI) models possess human-like mechanisms for abstract causal structure transfer is an open question. Using the OpenLock paradigm requiring sequential discovery of Common Cause (CC) and Common Effect (CE) structures, here we show that models exhibit fundamentally delayed or absent transfer: even successful models require initial environmental-specific mapping -- what we term environmental grounding -- before efficiency gains emerge, whereas humans leverage prior structural knowledge from the very first solution attempt. In the text-only condition, models matched or exceeded human discovery efficiency. In contrast, visual information -- in both the image-only and text-and-image conditions -- overall degraded rather than enhanced performance, revealing a broad reliance on symbolic processing rather than integrated multimodal reasoning. Models further exhibited systematic CC/CE asymmetries absent in humans, suggesting heuristic biases rather than direction-neutral causal abstraction. These findings reveal that large-scale statistical learning does not produce the decontextualized causal schemas underpinning human analogical reasoning, establishing grounding-dependent transfer as a fundamental limitation of current LLMs and VLMs.

title: An Information-Geometric Framework for Stability Analysis of Large Language Models under Entropic Stress
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes and operational settings, evaluation strategies based solely on aggregate accuracy are often insucient to characterize system reliability. This study proposes a thermodynamic inspired modeling framework for analyzing the stability of LLM outputs under conditions of uncertainty and perturbation. The framework introduces a composite stability score that integrates task utility, entropy as a measure of external uncertainty, and two internal structural proxies: internal integration and aligned reective capacity. Rather than interpreting these quantities as physical variables, the formulation is intended as an interpretable abstraction that captures how internal structure may modulate the impact of disorder on model behavior. Using the IST-20 benchmarking protocol and associated metadata, we analyze 80 modelscenario observations across four contemporary LLMs. The proposed formulation consistently yields higher stability scores than a reduced utilityentropy baseline, with a mean improvement of 0.0299 (95% CI: 0.02470.0351). The observed gain is more pronounced under higher entropy conditions, suggesting that the framework captures a form of nonlinear attenuation of uncertainty. We do not claim a fundamental physical law or a complete theory of machine ethics. Instead, the contribution of this work is a compact and interpretable modeling perspective that connects uncertainty, performance, and internal structure within a unied evaluation lens. The framework is intended to complement existing benchmarking approaches and to support ongoing discussions in AI safety, reliability, and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于热力学启发的建模框架，用于分析大语言模型在不确定性与扰动条件下的输出稳定性。该框架引入复合稳定性评分，整合任务效用、熵（外部不确定性）及两种内部结构代理指标，实验表明该评分在四种当代LLM的80个模型-场景观测中优于简化基线，尤其在高等熵条件下效果更显著。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估策略仅依赖聚合准确率，难以充分表征系统在高风险、操作环境下的可靠性，亟需更全面的稳定性评估方法。
AI.method: 提出热力学启发的建模框架，构建复合稳定性评分，综合任务效用、外部熵不确定性、内部集成能力与对齐反思能力四个维度，并通过IST-20基准协议对四种LLM进行80个模型-场景观测分析。
AI.result: 复合稳定性评分相比简化的效用-熵基线平均提升0.0299（95%置信区间：0.0247-0.0351），在高等熵条件下提升更为明显，表明框架捕捉到了不确定性的非线性衰减效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个紧凑且可解释的建模视角，将不确定性、性能与内部结构统一在评估框架内，可补充现有基准测试方法，支持AI安全、可靠性与治理讨论。

A thermodynamic-inspired modeling framework for quantifying LLM output stability under perturbation, using interpretable abstractions rather than physical variables.
A nonlinear uncertainty attenuation evaluation mechanism that captures the modulating effect of internal structure on model behavior under high-entropy conditions.

title: The Kerimov-Alekberli Model: An Information-Geometric Framework for Real-Time System Stability
summary: This study introduces the Kerimov-Alekberli model, a novel information-geometric framework that redefines AI safety by formally linking non-equilibrium thermodynamics to stochastic control for the ethical alignment of autonomous systems. By establishing a formal isomorphism between non-equilibrium thermodynamics and stochastic control, we define systemic anomalies as deviations from a Riemannian manifold. The model utilizes the Kullback-Leibler divergence as the primary metric, governed by a dynamic threshold derived from the Fisher Information Metric. We further ground this framework in the Landauer Principle, proving that adversarial perturbations perform measurable physical work by increasing the system's informational entropy. Validation on the NSL-KDD dataset and unmanned aerial vehicle trajectory simulations demonstrated that our model achieves effective real-time detection via the FPT trigger, with strong performance metrics (e.g., high accuracy and low FPR) on benchmark datasets. This study provides a rigorous physical foundation for AI safety, transitioning from heuristic, rule-based ethical frameworks to a thermodynamics-based stability paradigm by grounding ethical violations in quantifiable physical work and entropic information.

AI.tldr: 提出Kerimov-Alekberli模型，将非平衡热力学与随机控制形式同构，以信息几何框架从热力学第二定律角度重新定义AI安全与伦理对齐，在NSL-KDD数据集和无人机轨迹仿真上验证了基于FPT触发的实时异常检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全与伦理对齐依赖启发式规则和基于规则的框架，缺乏严谨的物理基础。该研究旨在将伦理违规量化为可测量的物理功和信息熵变化，从而建立热力学意义上的稳定性范式。
AI.method: 建立非平衡热力学与随机控制的形式同构，定义系统性异常为黎曼流形上的偏离；以KL散度为主要度量，Fisher信息度量导数的动态阈值加以控制；基于Landauer原理证明对抗扰动通过增加信息熵执行可测量的物理功；采用FPT触发机制进行实时检测。
AI.result: 在NSL-KDD数据集和无人机轨迹仿真上验证了模型的有效性，实现了高准确率和低假阳性率的实时检测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为AI安全提供了严谨的物理基础，将伦理对齐从启发式规则范式转向基于热力学的稳定性范式，实现了伦理违规的量化评估。

title: SemML 2.0: Synthesizing Controllers for LTL
summary: Synthesizing a reactive system from specifications given in linear temporal logic (LTL) is a classical problem, finding its applications in safety-critical systems design. These systems are typically represented using either Mealy machines or AIGER circuits. We present the second version of SemML, which outperforms all state-of-the-art tools for finding either solution. Aside from implementing the classical automata-theoretic approach, our tool utilizes partial exploration and machine-learning guidance for obtaining solutions efficiently, and numerous heuristics and improvements of classic algorithms for extracting small representations of these solutions. We evaluate our tool against the existing state-of-the-art tools (in particular Strix, LtlSynt, and the previous version of SemML) on the dataset of the synthesis competition SYNTCOMP. We show that we solve significantly more instances and do so much faster than other tools, while maintaining state-of-the-art solution quality.

AI.tldr: SemML第二版是一款用于LTL合成问题的工具，采用部分探索、机器学习引导及多种启发式算法，在SYNTCOMP数据集上显著超越Strix、LtlSynt等现有工具，在求解数量和速度上均达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 提升线性时序逻辑(LTL)反应式系统合成问题的求解效率与解的质量，超越现有工具的局限性。
AI.method: 融合经典自动机理论方法、部分探索(partial exploration)、机器学习引导策略、多种启发式算法以及对经典算法的改进，用于提取更紧凑的解决方案表示。
AI.result: 在SYNTCOMP数据集上，相比Strix、LtlSynt及上一版SemML，解决了更多实例，求解速度更快，且解的质量达到业界领先水平。

idea_en: A method for LTL reactive system synthesis using partial exploration combined with machine learning guidance to efficiently find solutions.
A technique for extracting compact representation of synthesized systems through improved classical algorithms and novel heuristics.
An integrated framework combining automata-theoretic approach with data-driven exploration strategies for LTL synthesis.
A system for representing reactive systems that optimizes both solution quality (circuit size) and solving speed via heuristic-enhanced automata methods.
